tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dpal ldan lha༄༅// dpal ldan lhan cig skyes ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga gsang chen mchog gi myur lam gsal ba'i 'dren pa bzhugs so//

oṃ sarba swasti sid+dhi hūm̐/ bla ma rigs bdag he ru ka dpal dang*// rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal te// mngon rtogs mchod phreng slob ma rjes 'dzin rnams// 'jug pa bde bar 'grig chags gsal brjod bya// bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i mngon par rtogs pa bsgom zhing slob ma gzhug par 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ ri bo'i rtse dang*/ dur khrod la sogs pa gnas dben par yar ngo'i tshes bcu la sogs pa dus khyad par can la/ khru gang ba'i maṇ+ḍal zlum po ba byung dang*/ chang dang dri'i chus byugs shing*/ der tshon gyis chos 'byung dmar po gru gsum bsnol ba'i nang du/ pad+ma 'dab bzhi phyogs kyi mdog can la/ lte bar gri gug /shar du rdo rje/ lhor rin po che/ nub tu pad+ma/ byang du ral gri bkod/ phyi rol du thod phreng dang rdo rje'i ra ba me ris bskor ba'i steng du/ khri'i khar rin po che'i bum pa dmar po la bi gh+nān+ta kṛta kyis bgegs bskrad nas/ lnga tshan lnga'i rdzas dang*/ chu gtsang mas bkang zhing*/ kha dog lnga pa'i dar gyis mgrin pa dkris la/ hūm̐ lan bdun bzlas pa'i skud pa dmar po bdun gyis bcings/ me tog 'bras bu dmar po can gyi yal 'dab kyis kha brgyan pa'i steng du/ thod pa bdud rtsi ril bu dang ldan pa'i btung ba bzang pos bkang ba hūm̐ gis bsngags nas bzhag la/ dar dmar pos dgab/ me long la sin dhū ra byugs te gser gyi smyug gus chos 'byung bsnol ma pad+ma dang bcas pa'i lte bar hrīḥphyogs bzhir ha ri ni sa/ mtha' mar bai ro tsa nī'i sngags kyis bskor ba'i sngags mgo rang la bstan zhing thod pa'i steng du bzhag /sku gsung thugs kyi rten dgram zhing*/ gnas mdzes par brgyan/ sha sna tshogs kyi gtor ma lnga dang*/ mchod yon/ me tog /spos kyi ril bu/ dri chab/ lha bshos la sogs pa'i mchod pa rnams kyang lnga tshan du bshams/ dus bzang gi tshogs mchod la sogs pa'i dus/

dkyil 'khor gyi g.yon phyogs su tshon gyis chos 'byung dmar po bris pa'i steng du shes rab kyi rdzas 'bru dang*/ bu ram dang*/ rgun 'brum dang*/ sbrang rtsi las byung ba'i btung ba bzang po rnams bzhag /g.yas phyogs su dga' ba 'khyil ba dkar po bris pa'i steng du/ thabs kyi rdzas sha dang*/ zan dang*/ 'bras chan dang*/ khur ba la sogs pa'i bza' ba rnams bzhag /mdun du lag mchod dang*/ ḍā ma ru/ rdo rje dril bu bkod de/ rnam par rtog pa nub pa'i brdar kha nub tu phyogs pas 'khod la/ sngon 'gro gtor ma bshams nas/ bdud rtsi lnga'i chus bsang zhing*/ bdag nyid skad cig gis rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis phyag g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug dang g.yon pas thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba bsnam pa gru mo na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga yod pa rgyan cha lugs thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i skur gyur/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharma swa bha wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can chang zung la yaṃ dang*/ mchog ma gnyis la g.yo ba'i ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po raṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du kaṃ gsum las thod pa bum ril gyi sgyed bu ltag pa nang du bstan pa gsum gyi steng du/ yi ge a yongs su gyur pa las ka pā la phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ dum bu gcig pa dpral ba rang la bstan pa/ rgya khyon chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa/ de'i dbus su mu las dri chu baiḍūr+ya lta bu/ shar du bi las dri chen shel lta bu/ lhor ra las rak+ta gser btso ma lta bu/ nub tu shu las byang sems dkar po/ byang du ma las klad pa/ slar yang dbus su na las mi'i sha /shar lhor go las ba lang gi sha /lho nub tu ku las khyi'i sha /nub byang du da las glang po che'i sha

/byang shar du ha las rta'i sha /de rnams slar yang yi ge de dag gis mtshan pa'o// rang gi sna bug g.yon pa nas rlung hūm̐ gi dbyibs can 'phros/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor la phog /ba dan bskyod pas rlung g.yos me sbar thod pa dros/ rdzas rnams khol/ nyes pa'i skyon rnams phyir lud/ de'i steng du oṃ āḥhūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug /dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang gnyis su med par 'dres/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥham̐'u/ lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis rlabs/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral bar bskor zhing*/ pheṃ pheṃ pheṃ/ zhes gtor mgron spyan drangs/ pad skor rdo rje thal mo kha phye bas/ oṃ badz+ra ā ra li hoḥdzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥbadz+ra ḍā ki ni sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ dṛ sh+ya hoḥ zhes lan gsum mam bzhi'am lngar brjod/ so so'i phyag rgyas/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shab+da āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ pad skor rdo rje thal mo kha phye bas/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba yak+ṣa rak+ṣa sa bhū ta pre ta pi sha tsa un+ma da a pa sma ra ḍā ka ḍā ki n+yā dā ya/ i dam ba liṃ gṛh+nan+tu sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu ma ma sarba sid+dhi m+me pra ya ts+tshan+tu ya thai baṃ ya thaiṣ+ṭaṃḥbhūñdza tha dzi gh+ra tha pi ba tha ma ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba kā ra ta ya sa ta su khaṃ bi shud+dha ye/ sa hā yi ka bha wan+tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ lan bzhir brjod/ zhing skyong chen po brgyad rnams dang*// mkha' 'gro sum cu so gnyis sogs// ma lus 'khor bcas 'dir byon zhing*// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang*// longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs// dngos grub kun gyi sdong grogs mdzod// dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*// gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// 'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang*// bde legs phun sum tshogs pa dang*// yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod// gang dag nag po'i phyogs gyur zhing*// gsang sngags zab mo'i cho ga la// nyan dang lta bar mi dbang ba// de dag thams cad gzhan du gdengs// gal te bka' las 'da' byed na// rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ rab 'bar bas// mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas 'gyur// gtor ma phyi rol du dor zhing*/

oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇā pa ya gṛh+ṇā pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya hoḥbha ga wā na bid+yā rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ 'og thams cad rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ bar thams cad rdo rje'i ra ba/ steng thams cad rdo rje'i dra ba dang*/ gur bla bres su gyur/ hūm̐ 'di ltar lha mo ya mtshan can// lha mo'i lus la seng gdong ma// badz+ra singha zhes bya ba// steng sgo srung ba'i phra men ma// dzaḥ phra men rdo rje'i dus la bab// steng gi bar chad zlog tu gsol// hūm̐ 'di ltar lha mo ya mtshan can// lha mo'i lus la khwa gdong ma// badz+ra kā ka zhes bya ba// shar sgo srung ba'i phra men ma// dzaḥphra men rdo rje'i dus la bab// shar gyi bar chad zlog tu gsol// hūm̐ 'di ltar lha mo ya mtshan can// lha mo'i lus la 'ug gdong ma// badz+ra ul+lu zhes bya ba// byang sgo srung ba'i phra men ma// dzaḥphra men rdo rje'i dus la bab// byang gi bar chad zlog tu gsol// hūm̐ 'di ltar lha mo ya mtshan can// lha mo'i lus la khyi gdong ma// badz+ra shwa na zhes bya ba// nub sgo srung ba'i phra men ma// dza phra men rdo rje'i dus la bab// nub kyi bar chad zlog tu gsol// hūm̐ 'di ltar lha mo ya mtshan can// lha mo'i lus la phag gdong ma// badz+ra su ka zhes bya ba// lho sgo srung ba'i phra men ma// dzaḥ phra men rdo rje'i dus la bab// lho yi bar chad zlog tu gsol// hūm̐ 'di ltar lha mo ya mtshan can// lha mo'i lus la stag gdong ma// badz+ra bya gh+ri zhes bya ba// 'og sgo srung ba'i phra men ma// dzaḥphra men rdo rje'i dus la bab// 'og gi bar chad zlog tu gsol// hūm̐ 'di ltar lha mo ya mtshan can// sgo ma rnams kyis sgo srungs la// mtshams ma rnams kyis mtshams sdoms shig /phyi nang bar chad zlog tu gsol// oṃ badz+ra bā rā hi hrīḥgha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/

gnod byed sarba duṣ+ṭān hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ mtshams bcad do// las kyi rdo rjes phyag 'tshal nas/ ting nge 'dzin la bskul ba ni/ rdo rje 'dzin sogs dgongs su gsol// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro mnyes bya dang*// yon bdag bsod nams bskyed bya'i phyir// gnyis med ting 'dzin sa la bzhugs// sa mā dhi kra ma ho/ mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta sogs/ swā bhā wa sogs/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las a las thod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ hūm̐ yig gi tshogs dpag tu med pa 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i rdo rje'i mchod yon/ me tog /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa mchod pa'i dngos po dwangs shing thogs pa med pa byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po las kyang ches cher lhag pa'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po rab 'byams nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i bar rgyas par 'gengs shing*/ 'phags pa rnams mnyes par byed pa/ dus 'khor ba ji srid ma stong gi bar du rgyun mi chad par 'byung ba'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ a lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wid+ye/ shab+da āḥhūm̐/ bdag dang nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bor gyur pa/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag /drin chen rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la= dam pa'i chos rnams la= 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la=

dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// lan gsum mam/ nyer gcig gam/ brgya la sogs pa bya/ phyogs bcu dus gsum bzhugs pa yi// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// bcom ldan rdo rje 'dzin dbang po// rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// sems can rnams kyi don slad du// byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed ltar// de bzhin bdag gis sems bskyed do// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// bsod nams ye shes byang chub lam// thabs dang shes rab gom pas bgrod// de bzhin bdag gis lam bgrod do// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// thams cad mkhyen par sangs rgyas nas// mkha' mnyam sems can don mdzad ltar// de bzhin bdag gis don bgyi'o// ma bsgral ba rnams sgrol ba dang*// ma grol ba rnams dgrol ba dang*// dbugs ma phyung rnams dbugs dbyung zhing*// 'gro kun mya ngan 'da' ba dang*// kun kyang sangs rgyas thob par shog /ces sems bskyed/ bdag nyid kyi spyi bor pad zla la hūm̐ las rdor sems he ru ka sku mdog dkar po/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis phyag g.yas rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin cing*/ g.yon dril bu snyems pa dkur brten pa/ dar dang rus pa dang*/ rin po ches brgyan pa/ zhabs sems skyil gyis bzhugs pa'i pang du yum rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo gri thod can gyis 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'i gnas gsum du yi ge 'bru gsum dang khyad par yab kyi thugs kar zla ba la hūm̐ gi mthar yig brgya dkar pos bskor ba/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ rang 'dra'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dam tshig pa la thim/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥganyis su med par gyur/ slar yang hūm̐ gyi 'od kyi dbang lha spyan drangs te dbang bskur/ bdud rtsis sku gang*/ chu lhag spyi bor 'khyil pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/

bcom ldan 'das bdag gi sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ thugs ka'i sngags 'khor las bdud rtsi babs/ rdor sems kyi sku gang sbyor mtshams nas lud de/ rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs pas sdig sgrib nyes ltung rnam smin gyi phung po dang bcas pa dag nas rang lus 'od gsal bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra he ru ka sa twa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra sa twa twe no pa/ tiṣ+ṭha dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhi m+me pra ya ts+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+taṃ shri yaḥku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wan/ sarba ta thā ga tā badz+ra mā me muñtsa badz+rī bhā wa ma hā sa ma ya sa twa āḥ zhes ci nus bzlas/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa hūm̐/ mgon po bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yis// dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams// bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa kye// thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can// 'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rdo rje sems dpa'i zhal nas/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyi sdig sgrib thams cad dag go zhes gsungs shing*/ mthar rdor sems 'od du zhu nas/ rang nyid la thim par gyur/ ces pa 'di ni 7rje dpa' bo gtsug lag rgya mtshos mdzad pa'o// mdun gyi nam mkhar rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa gsal bar gyur/ bdag nyid skad cig gis rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i rtsa gsum 'dus mdor yi ge hrīḥdamar po tsheg drag dang bcas pa de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ o rgyan gyi gnas nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa la/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

hūm̐/ bzhengs shig bzhengs shig stobs bcu mnga' ba'i lha// dus las mi 'da' thugs rje'i dbang gis ni// sems can don la dgongs pa'i bla med dkon mchog gsum// dngos dang yid kyis bshams shing mchod pa'i gnas 'di ru// rgyal ba 'khor bcas ma lus spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs// bdag cag bsod nams skal ba ldan// bdag gi mchod yon bzhes slad du// 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol// stong gsum kun dang mnyam pa yi// pad+ma 'dab brgyad ge sar bcas// bde zhing yangs par 'bul lags na// ci bde bar ni bzhugs su gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/ nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor dang gnyis su med par gyur/ e ma ho ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo nyid// 'khor 'das yon tan dpal dang ldan// bka' brgyud rin po che la phyag 'tshal bstod// bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos// bla ma dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang*// kun gyi byed pa bla ma yin// bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod// ston pa bla med sangs rgyas rin po che// skyob pa bla med dam chos rin po che// 'dren pa bla med dge 'dun rin po che// bla med dkon mchog gsum la= smra bsam brjod med shes rab pha rol phyin// ma skyes mi 'gag nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid// so sor rang rig ye shes spyod yul ba// dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum la= chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang*// gzugs sku 'ja' tshon bzhin du so sor gsal// thabs dang shes rab mchog la mnga' brnyes pa'i// rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la= grags chain shes rab chen po pa// thub chen dpa' bo chen po pa// srid pa'i mya ngan brgal ba po// bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong la sogs// sras dang bcas la= phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba ma lus dang*// byang chub sems dang rgyal sras ma lus tshogs// rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed bzhugs pa yi// bla med 'phags pa'i tshogs la=

dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor lo sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsung thugs// 'gro ba skyob la= ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// kun tu rtog pa 'ching gcod cing*// 'jig rten bya bar rab 'jug ma// de snyed rnams la= lte ba'i dbus nas 'byung bzhi 'phro// chos dang longs spyod rdzogs par ldan// mkha' 'gro ma rnams sdud mdzad ma// rje btsun ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces phyag 'tshal/ lte ba'i sa bon las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyi tshogs las byung ba'i mchod pa'i lha mo sna tshogs pa dag gis mngon par mchod de/ phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye ha ri ni sa shrī badz+ra yo gi nī ār+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes 'don pa bsgyur te/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shab+da/ zhes dang*/ pañtsa a mṛ ta/ zhes dang*/ mā taṅgi/ zhes pas mchod de/ ji snyed su dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na// dus gsum gshegs pa mi yi seng ge kun// bdag gis ma lus de dag thams cad la// lus dang ngag yid dang bas phyag bgyi'o// bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam stobs dag gis// rgyal ba thams cad yid kyi mngon sum du// zhing gi rdul snyed lus rab btud pa yis// rgyal ba kun la rab tu phyag 'tshal lo// rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed sangs rgyas rnams// sangs rgyas sras kyi dbus na bzhugs pa dag /de ltar chos kyi dbyings rnams ma lus pa// thams cad rgyal ba dag gis gang bar mos// de dag bsngags pa mi zad rgya mtsho rnams// dbyangs kyi yan lag rgya mtsho'i sgra kun gyis// rgyal ba kun gyi yon tan rab brjod cing*// bde bar gshegs pa thams cad bdag gis bstod// me tog dam pa phreng ba dam pa dang*// sil snyan rnams dang byug pa gdugs mchog dang*// mar me mchog dang bdug spos dam pa yis// rgyal ba de dag la ni mchod par bgyi// na bza' dam pa rnams dang dri mchog dang*// phye ma'i phur ma ri rab mnyam pa dang*// bkod pa khyad par 'phags pa'i mchog kun gyis// rgyal ba de dag la yang mchod par bgyi// mchod pa gang rnams bla med rgya che ba// de dag rgyal ba thams cad la yang mos// bzang po spyod la dad pa'i stobs dag gis// rgyal ba kun la phyag 'tshal mchod par bgyi// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dbang gis ni// lus dang ngag dang de bzhin yid kyis kyang*// sdig pa bdag gis bgyis pa ci mchis pa// de dag thams cad bdag gis sau sor bshags// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba kun dang sangs rgyas sras// rang rgyal rnams dang slob dang mi slob dang*// 'gro ba kun gyi bsod nams gang la yang*// de dag kun gyi rjes su bdag yi rang*// gang rnams phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten sgron ma dag

/byang chub rim par sangs rgyas ma chags brnyes// mgon po de dag bdag gis thams cad la// 'khor lo bla na med pa bskor bar bskul// mya ngan 'da' ston gang bzhed de dag la// 'gro ba kun la phan zhing bde ba'i phyir// bskal pa zhing gi rdul snyed bzhugs par yang*// bdag gis thal mo rab sbyar gsol bar bgyi// phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod cing bshags pa dang*// rjes su yi rang bskul zhing gsol ba yi// dge ba cung zad bdag gis ci bsags pa// thams cad byang chub chen po'i phyir bsngo'o// maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba ni/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya sogs/ sa twa āḥ oṃ badz+ra bhū mi āḥhūm̐/ gzhi rnam par dag pa rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi sa gzhi/ oṃ badz+ra re khe āḥhūm̐/ phyi rdo rje'i ri'i 'khor yug gi ra bas yongs su bskor ba'i dbus su ri'i rgyal po ri bo mchog rab/ shar lus 'phags po/ lho 'dzam bu gling*/ nub ba lang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyan/ byang shar du zla ba/ lho nub tu nyi ma/ lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i rdul gyi grangs las 'das pa mngon par bkod de/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul bar bgyi'o// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol// phyogs bcu dus gsum bzhugs pa yi// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// bla ma rdo rje slob dpon dang*// yi dam lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas// dus gsum bde gshegs ma lus la// gling bzhi ri rab bcas pa dang*// gling bzhi bye ba phrag brgya dang*// bye ba 'bum dang dung phyur te// maṇ+ḍal gcig tu bsdus nas ni// mos blos gong ma rnams la 'bul// thugs rjes brtser dgongs bzhes su gsol// bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol// oṃ maṇ+ḍal pū dza me gha sa mu drā s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/

mnyes byed maṇ+ḍal bzang po 'di phul bas// byang chub lam la bar chad mi 'byung zhing*// dus gsum bde gshegs dgongs pa rtogs pa dang*// srid par mi 'khrul zhi bar mi gnas shing*// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i 'gro ba sgrol bar shog /bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi lus longs spyod dge ba'i rtsa ba dang bcas pa thams cad bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la 'bul bar bgyi'o// bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum gyi thugs kyi dgongs pa khyad par can gong nas gong du yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig /de'i bsod nams gang lags pa de 'gro ba rigs drug gi sems can rnams la byin pas rigs drug so so'i sdug bsngal dang nyes dmigs ci yod pa las grol zhing thar nas myur du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob par gyur cig /thams cad mkhyen gzigs lha rnams dgongs su gsol// thog ma med pa'i dus nas bdag cag gis// dug gsum dbang gis lus ngag yid gsum gyis// sdom gsum rgyal ba'i bka' las 'das gyur pa// nyes ltung sdig pa'i las bgyis mthol lo bshags// slan chad mi bgyid myong bar ma gyur cig /dkon mchog rin chen gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// dge ba 'di yis nye bar mtshon nas ni// sems can rnams kyis dus gsum bsags pa yi// zag bcas zag med zung 'jug dge ba rnams// bla med byang chub chen por bsngo bar bgyi// 'gro kun thams cad mkhyen pa thob par shog /na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ zung 'jug bde ba chen po'i pho brang nas// bde gshegs rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs// rang sems chos skur rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// 'gre'o// gnyis med mkha' dbyings dag pa'i pho brang nas// rgyal sras tai lo pa la= rang sems= gsal stong 'ja' tshon lta bu'i pho brang nas// mkhas mchog nā ro pa la= rang sems= spros bral mtshan ma med pa'i pho brang nas// mar pa lho brag pa la=

rang sems= snang stong sgyu ma lta bu'i pho brang nas// dbang phyug mi la'i sku la= rang sems= skye 'gag gnas dang bral ba'i pho brang nas// mnyam med sgam po pa la= rang sems = zag med shes bya kun mkhyen pho brang nas// dpal ldan dus gsum mkhyen la= rang sems= dri med yon tan phun tshogs pho brang nas// 'gro mgon ras chen pa la= rang sems= bskyed rdzogs brtan pa thob pa'i pho brang nas// rgyal sras spom brag pa la= rang sems= snang srid dbang du bsdus pa'i pho brang nas// grub chen karma pa la= rang sems= shes dang shes bya kun mkhyen pho brang nas// mkhas grub u rgyan pa la= rang sems= rang gzhan don gnyis grub pa'i pho brang nas// chos rje rin po che la= rang sems= snang ba chu zla lta bu'i pho brang nas// rgyal ba g.yung ston pa la= rang sems= sku gsum dbyer med lhun grub pho brang nas// rang byung sprul pa'i sku la= rang sems= stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pho brang nas// mtshungs med mkha' spyod dbang la= rang sems= mkhyen brtse nus mthu rmad byung pho brang nas// thub chen chos kyi rje la= rang sems= kun gzigs dbang 'byor lhun grub pho brang nas// rigs pa'i ral gri'i zhabs la= rang sems= zab yangs rnam thar rgya mtsho'i pho brang nas// mthong ba don ldan zhabs la= rang sems= chos rnams mkha' ltar dag pa'i pho brang nas// 'jam dpal bzang po'i zhabs la= rang sems= rnam dag phrin las rgya mtsho'i pho brang nas// dpal 'byor don grub zhabs la= rang sems= lhun grub rgyun mi 'chad pa'i pho brang nas// rang byung mtsho skyes zhabs la= rang sems= chos dbyings rab 'byams yangs pa'i pho brang nas// bkra shis dpal 'byor zhabs la= rang sems= zab zhi spros dang bral ba'i pho brang nas// mi bskyod rdo rje'i zhabs la= rang sems= dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med pho brang nas// dkon mchog yan lag zhabs la= rang sems= kun khyab thugs rje chen po'i pho brang nas// dbang phyug rdo rje'i zhabs la=

rang sems= 'gro ba'i re 'dod skong ba'i pho brang nas// chos kyi dbang phyug zhabs la= rang sems= phrin las lhun gyis grub pa'i pho brang nas// chos dbyings rdo rje'i zhabs la= rang sems= mkha' khyab rdo rje 'dzin pa'i pho brang nas// ye shes snying po'i zhabs la= rang sems= zab gsal gnyis med chos dbyings pho brang nas// ye shes rdo rje'i zhabs la= rang sems= don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i pho brang nas// chos kyi don grub zhabs la= rang sems= mtha' yas 'gro rnams sgrol ba'i pho brang nas// byang chub rdo rje'i zhabs la= rang sems= dri med zab gsal gar gyi pho brang nas// chos kyi 'byung gnas zhabs la= rang sems= phyogs las rnam rgyal chos kyi pho brang nas// bdud 'dul rdo rje'i zhabs la= rang sems= rigs dang dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i pho brang nas// chos grub rgya mtsho'i zhabs la= rang sems= bde stong chos dbyings 'gyur med pho brang nas// pad+ma nyin byed dbang por= rang sems= bral smin yon tan lhun rdzogs pho brang nas// theg mchog rdo rje'i zhabs la= rang sems= rlung sems dhu tīr dag pa'i pho brang nas// blo gros mtha' yas zhabs la= rang sems= snang srid rnam dag lhun grub pho brang nas// mkha' khyab rdo rje'i zhabs la= rang sems= bde chen 'gyur ba med pa'i pho brang nas// pad+ma dbang mchog zhabs la= rang sems= snang stong spros dang bral ba'i pho brang nas// dpal ldan mkhyen brtse'i zhabs la= rang sems= phrin las rgyun mi 'chad pa'i pho brang nas// rig pa'i rdo rje'i zhabs la= rang sems= spyi gtsug bde ba chen po'i pho brang nas// rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhabs la= rang sems= bdud bzhi g.yul las rgyal ba'i pho brang nas// rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la= rang sems= bgegs dang log 'dren 'joms mdzad pho brang nas// chos skyong ma mgon gnyis la gsol ba 'debs// rang sems chos skur rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// khyod la gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs kyis// 'gro rnams ma rig mun pa rab bsal nas// thar pa chen po'i lam mchog rab bgrod de// rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas go 'phang thob par shog

/lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs ka nas ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin gyi 'od zer kha dog lnga byung nas bdag gi gnas lngar thim pas sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dag nas rang nyid lha mo lnga'i rang bzhin du byas te/ de nas tshogs zhing gi ye shes pa thams cad rang gi snying ga'i gnas su thim par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig /sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig /sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dam pa dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /nye ring chags sdang gnyis dang bral ba'i btang snyoms chen po la gnas par gyur cig /oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dhau3haṃ/ gzung ba dang 'dzin pas bsdus pa'i chos thams cad stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa/ rtsa ba phra ba thur du zug pa/ kha gdengs che ba gyen du bstan pa/ phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ yangs shing rgya che ba de'i dbus su gdan pad+ma ro dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan gyi steng du/ rang gi rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo yi ge hrīḥdamar po tsheg drag dang bcas pa de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad la phog /sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dag nas jo mo'i skur gyur/ tshur 'dus hrīḥl thim pas chu la nya ldang ba'i tshul du rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur pa ni/ de yang chos thams cad chos kyi skur ro gcig pa'i phyir zhal gcig dang ldan pa/ thabs dang shes rab zung du 'jug pa'i phyir phyag gnyis dang ldan pa/ rab tu 'jigs pa'i sku bdud dpung gi tshogs la khros shing cher khros pa/ sku mdog dmar zhing 'od zer rab tu 'bar bas stong gsum thams cad khyab cing rten pa dang g.yo ba'i bcud 'phrog par byed pa/ phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje'i gri gug dang thod khrag bsnams shing gar stabs su 'gying ba/

yab he ru ka sbas pa'i tshul du sbyor bas kha ṭ+wāṃ ga mchan khung na yar bsgreng ba/ bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod ltar bcud kyis rgyas shing nu ma 'bur ba/ dus gsum mkhyen phyir rab tu gtum pa'i spyan gsum khrag ltar dmar zhing zlum la g.yo ba/ bdud bzhi 'dul ba'i phyir khro gnyer dang mche ba rnam par gtsigs shing ma mchu tshems kyis mnan pa/ dbu skra kham nag gyen du brdzes pa la rigs lngas mtshan pa'i phyir thod pa skam po lnga'i phreng bas dbu la brgyan pa/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyir thal ba spangs pa'i phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ 'du byed lnga bcu rtsa gcig yongs su dag pa'i phyir thod rlon lnga bcu rtsa gcig gis do shal byas pa/ me tog dmar po'i phreng ba dang dril bu g.yer kha dang rus pa'i rgyan cha du mas brgyan pa/ 'khor 'das gnyis kyi mtha' la mi gnas pa'i phyir gdan pad+ma ro dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan gyi steng du zhabs brkyang bskum gyis gar stabs su bzhugs pa'o// gzhung du/ de yi 'khor lo rnam bzhi la// mkha' 'gro sde bzhi 'khor bcas bskyed// ces dang*/ mar pa'i zhal gdams las/ de'i spyi bor ha las rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis phyag g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug dang*/ g.yon pas thod pa bdud rtsis bkang ba bsnams pa/ gru mo na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bcug pa/ 'khor rgyan cha lugs de dang 'dra ba'i dpa' mo sum cu so gnyis kyis bskor ba/ mgrin par ri las rin chen mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis phyag g.yas rin po ches mtshan pa'i gri gug dang*/ g.yon pas thod pa bdud rtsis bkang ba bsnams pa/ gru mo na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bcug pa/ 'khor rgyan cha lugs de dang 'dra ba'i dpa' mo bcu drug gis bskor ba/ snying gar ni las pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis phyag g.yas pad+mas mtshan pa'i gri gug dang*/

g.yon pas thod pa bdud rtsis bkang ba bsnams pa/ gru mo na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bcug pa/ 'khor rgyan cha lugs de dang 'dra ba'i dpa' mo brgyad kyis bskor ba/ lte bar sa las las kyi mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog ljang khu zhal gcig phyag gnyis phyag g.yas ral gris mtshan pa'i gri gug dang*/ g.yon pas thod pa bdud rtsis bkang ba bsnams pa/ gru mo na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bcug pa/ 'khor rgyan cha lugs de dang 'dra ba'i dpa' mo drug cu rtsa bzhis bskor ba'o// gtso mo'i gsang gnas su chos 'byung gru gsum me yi dkyil 'khor lta bu'i dbus su yi ge hrīḥdamar po 'khor gyi mkha' 'gro ma bzhi'i thugs kar ha ri ni sa yi ge lnga las 'od zer 'phros pas/ o rgyan gyi gnas nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa la bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ de rnams kyi sku las rje btsun ma gtso 'khor gyi sku dpag tu med pa byon/ spyi bor thim/ bde ba dang nus pa bskyed/ de rnams kyi gsung las sngags ā li kā li dkar po dang dmar po'i phreng ba byung*/ mgrin par thim/ mthu dang nus pa bskyed/ de rnams kyi thugs las byang chub sems kyi chu rgyun ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin byon/ snying gar thim/ bde stong gi ye shes rgyud la skyes/ lha mo de rnams rang rang gi sku la thim pas gnyis su med par gyur/ gtso mo'i gsang gnas su chos 'byung gi dbus na hrīḥdamar po la g.yon du bskor ba'i sngags phreng dang mkha' 'gro ma bzhi'i thugs ka'i yi ge la dmigs te bzlas pa bya/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye ha ri ni sa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ rdzogs rim ni/ phyi rol snod bcud rten gzhal yas khang 'khor dang bcas pa bdag nyid la 'dus/ bdag nyid kyang spyi bo dang zhabs mthil nas 'dus te/ gsang gnas kyi sngags 'khor dang hrīḥl thim/

de yang thig le dang nā da las 'das nas don dam pa stong pa nyid do// zhes ci gnas su bzhag la/ slar yang de nyid kyi ngang las stong bzhin du nye bar snang ba sgyu ma'i dpe bcu gnyis kyis khyad par du byas pa'i zung 'jug gzugs kyi sku zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod pa bsnams pa sku mdog dmar mo phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa gsal bar gyur/ bdag bskyed do// lag pa'i mchod pa'i cho ga ni/ bdud rtsi ril bu dang ldan pa'i myos byed la/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shud+dhonya haṃ/ zlum bskor/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gyis chos 'byung dbus dang phyogs bzhir/ hrīḥha ri ni sa/ thig le lnga bya/ chos 'byung gru gsum gyi gzhal yas khang chen po'i dbus su gdan pad+ma ro dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan gyi steng du/ dbus su hrīḥdamar po/ shar du ha sngon po/ lhor ri ser po/ nub tu ni dmar po/ byang du sa ljang gu/ de dag las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad la phog /sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dag nas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma lha lnga'i rang bzhin du gyur/ chang gtor zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye ha ri ni sa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ lag gnyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shud+dhonya haṃ/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mthil du zlum bskor/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gyis chos 'byung bya/ hrīḥha ri ni sa dbus dang phyogs bzhir thig le lnga bya/ chos 'byung gru gsum gyi gzhal yas khang chen po'i dbus su gdan pad+ma ro dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan gyi steng du/ dbus su hrīḥdamar po/ shar du ha sngon po/ lhor ri ser po/ nub tu ni dmar po/ byang du sa ljang khu/ de dag las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad la phog /sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dag nas/

tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis phyag g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug dang*/ g.yon pas thod pa bdud rtsis bkang ba bsnams pa/ gru mo na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga yod pa/ rgyan cha lugs thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ de'i shar du ha las rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog sngon mo/ lhor ri las rin chen mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog ser mo/ nub tu ni las pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog dmar mo/ byang du sa las las kyi mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog ljang khu/ de dag thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje dang*/ rin po che dang*/ pad+ma dang*/ ral gris mtshan pa'i gri gug 'dzin zhing*/ g.yon pa rnams kyis thod pa bdud rtsis bkang ba bsnams pa/ gru mo na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga yod pa/ rgyan cha lugs thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye ha ri ni sa shrī badz+ra yo gi nī badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shab+da āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ pañtsa a mṛ ta āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ mā taṅgi āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor lo bsgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsung thugs// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal bstod// ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// kun tu rtog pa 'ching gcod cing*// 'jig rten bya ba rab 'jug ma// de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod// lte ba'i dbus nas 'byung bzhi 'phro// chos dang longs spyod rdzogs par ldan// mkha' 'gro ma rnams sdud mdzad ma// rje btsun ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// rang gi lte ba'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis ye shes pa spyan drangs par bsam la/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha// dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i// bcom ldan rdo rje phag mo 'khor bcas rnams// sems can don la dgongs mdzod la// skad cig tsam gyis gshegs su gsol// oṃ e ā ra li hoḥbadz+ra wārā hī/

dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra ḍā ki nī ye/ rat+na ḍā ki nī ye/ pad+ma ḍā ki nī ye/ karma ḍā ki nī ye/ bi shwa ḍā ki nī ye/ lo ka ḍā ki nī ye/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ dṛ sh+yaho/ pheṃ pheṃ pheṃ/ oṃ shrī badz+ra wārā hī/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shab+da āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ pañtsa a mṛ ta āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ mā taṅgi āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ oṃ/ bcom ldan mgon po dpa' bo chen po ni// bskal pa'i me dpung lta bur rab tu 'bar// ral pa'i cod pan dbu yi rgyan du bcings// mche ba rab gtsigs drag shul 'jigs pa'i zhal// dbu la spyan gsum gzi brjid ldan pa po// dgra s+t+wa zhags pa kha ṭ+wāṃ mdung rtse bsnams// rab 'jigs stag gi pags pa sku la gsol// sku chen dud ka bgegs 'dul mdzad la 'dud// bcom ldan rnam kun rdo rje phag mo che// 'jig rten gsum gzhan rgol bas mi tshugs shing*// 'byung po'i 'jigs pa ma lus rdo rje phag mos 'joms// rdo rje gdan bzhugs tshangs pa las rgyal zhing*// bdud kyi 'jigs pa ma lus skems shing pham mdzad ma// skyes gnas 'byung ba kun gyi rang bzhin gzugs// sa gsum dbang phyug chos rnams yongs rdzogs mdzad// rnal 'byor 'dod pa'i dbang phyug ma la 'dud// nam mkha'i lha tshogs rnams lag pa'i lha tshogs la thim/ lag pa'i lha tshogs rnams chang nang gi lha tshogs la thim pas thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis bdud rtsi blangs nas phyogs mtshams su gtor zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye ha ri ni sa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ phyi rol gyi bgegs dang ma dag pa'i tshogs tshar bcad nas mkha' 'gro ma'i drwa gur bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i rang bzhin du gyur/ rang la gtor la/ rang gi ba spu'i bu ga thams cad kyang mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs kyis gang bar gyur/

tshogs dang mchod rdzas la gtor la/ mchod pa'i yo byad thams cad bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur/ rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang*/ yi dam chos skyong gi mtshan smos te/ ༈ byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba bka' brgyud bla ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dngos grub kyi rtsa ba yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du= phrin las ky-i rtsa ba chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi zhal du= gzhan yang 'gro ba rigs drug lam brgyud lnga skye gnas rnam pa bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad yi dam gyi lhar gsal ba'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐ gyis dbul lo// rang gi lce thog tu bzhag nas bdud rtsi myang la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod do// ༈ //bum bskyed ni/ bdud rtsi gtor la/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharma swa bhā wa shu d+dhonya haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rāt+s+mum̐ las rin po che'i bum pa dmar po/ rtsa ba dang nag po med pa/ lto ba yangs pa/ mgrin pa ring ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyis mgrin par dkris pa/ tsū ta'i shing gi yal ga dmar pos kha brgyan pa/ de'i nang du sman lnga/ 'bru lnga/ rin po che lnga/ dri lnga/ snying po lnga rnams dang*/ lha'i bdud rtsi'i chus gang ba'i dbus su e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa rtsa ba phra ba thur du zug pa/ kha gdengs che ba gyen du bstan pa/ phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ yangs shing rgya che ba de'i dbus su gdan pad+ma ro dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan gyi steng du yi ge hrīḥdamar po tsheg drag dang bcas pa de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad la phog /sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dag nas jo mo'i skur gyur/ tshur 'dus hrīḥl thim pas chu la nya ldang ba'i tshul du rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur pa ni/ de yang chos thams cad chos kyi skur ro gcig pa'i phyir zhal gcig dang ldan pa/ thabs dang shes rab zung du 'jug pa'i phyir phyag gnyis dang ldan pa/

rab tu 'jigs pa'i sku bdud dpung gi tshogs la khros shing cher khros pa/ sku mdog dmar zhing 'od zer rab tu 'bar bas stong gsum thams cad khyab cing rten pa dang g.yo ba'i bcud 'phrog par byed pa/ phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje'i gri gug dang thod khrag bsnams shing gar stabs su 'gying ba/ yab he ru ka sbas pa'i tshul du sbyor bas kha ṭ+wāṃ ga mchan khung na yar bsgreng ba/ bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod ltar bcud kyis rgyas shing nu ma 'bur ba/ dus gsum mkhyen phyir rab tu gtum pa'i spyan gsum khrag ltar dmar zhing zlum la g.yo ba/ bdud bzhi 'dul ba'i phyir khro gnyer dang mche ba rnam par brtsigs shing ma mchu tshems kyis mnan pa/ dbu skra khams nag gyen du brdzes pa la rigs lngas mtshan pa'i phyir thod pa skam po lnga'i phreng bas dbu la brgyan pa/ pha rol du phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyir thal ba spangs pa'i phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ 'du byed lnga bcu rtsa gcig yongs su dag pa'i phyir thod rlon lnga bcu rtsa gcig gis do shal byas pa/ me tog dmar po'i phreng ba dang dril bu g.yer kha dang rus pa'i rgyan cha du mas brgyan pa/ 'khor 'das gnyis kyi mtha' la mi gnas pa'i phyir gdan pad+ma ro dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du zhabs brkyang bskum gyi gar stabs su bzhugs pa'o// de'i shar du ha las rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog sngon mo/ lhor ri las rin chen mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog ser mo/ nub tu ni las pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog dmar mo/ byang du sa las las kyi mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog ljang khu/ de thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje dang*/ rin po che dang*/ pad+ma dang*/ ral gris mtshan pa'i gri gug bsnams pa/ g.yon pa rnams kyis thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams pa/ gru mo na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga yod pa/ rgyan cha lugs thams cad gtso mo dang mtshungs pa'o// gtso mo'i gsang gnas su chos 'byung gru gsum me'i dkyil 'khor lta bu'i dbus su yi ge hrīḥdamar po 'khor gyi mkha' 'gro ma bzhi'i thugs kar ha ri ni sa yi ge lnga las 'od zer 'phros pas/

rang bzhin gyi gnas dang o rgyan gyi gnas nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa/ dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi sbyor mtshams nas sku gsung thugs byang sems dkar dmar gyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ me long gi sngags 'khor dang*/ thod pa'i bdud rtsi/ bum pa'i lha tshogs rnams la dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye ha ri ni sa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ dmigs pa de lta bus bum pa sogs la bzlas pa bya/ me long*/ thod pa/ bum pa bdud rtsis rim bzhin khengs nas bum lha zhu bar gyur// ༈ //mdun bskyed ni/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dhonya haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi nam mkhar e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa/ rtsa ba phra ba thur du zug pa/ kha gdengs che ba gyen du bstan pa/ phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ yangs shing rgya che ba de'i dbus su gdan pad+ma ro dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan gyi steng du yi ge hrīḥdamar po tsheg drag dang bcas pa de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad la phog /sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dag nas jo mo'i skur gyur/ tshur 'dus hrīḥl thim pas chu la nya ldang ba'i tshul du rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur pa ni/ de yang chos thams cad chos kyi skur ro gcig pa'i phyir zhal gcig dang ldan pa/ thabs dang shes rab zung du 'jug pa'i phyir phyag gnyis dang ldan pa/ rab tu 'jigs pa'i sku bdud dpung gi tshogs la khros shing cher khros pa/ sku mdog dmar zhing 'od zer rab tu 'bar bas stong gsum thams cad khyab cing rten pa dang g.yo ba'i bcud 'phrog par byed pa/ phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje'i gri gug dang thod khrag bsnams shing gar stabs su 'gying ba/ yab he ru ka sbas pa'i tshul du sbyor bas kha ṭ+wāṃ ga mchan khung na yar bsgreng ba/

bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod ltar bcud kyis rgyas shing nu ma 'bur ba/ dus gsum mkhyen phyir rab tu gtum pa'i spyan gsum khrag ltar dmar zhing zlum la g.yo ba/ bdud bzhi 'dul ba'i phyir khro gnyer dang mche ba rnam par brtsigs shing ma mchu tshems kyis mnan pa/ dbu skra kham nag gyen du brdzes pa la rigs lngas mtshan pa'i phyir thod pa skam po lnga'i phreng bas dbu la brgyan pa/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyir thal ba spangs pa'i phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ 'du byed lnga bcu rtsa gcig yongs su dag pa'i phyir thod rlon lnga bcu rtsa gcig gis do shal byas pa/ me tog dmar po'i phreng ba dang dril bu g.yer kha dang rus pa'i rgyan cha du mas brgyan pa/ 'khor 'das gnyis kyi mtha' la mi gnas pa'i phyir gdan pad+ma ro dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan gyi steng du zhabs brkyang bskum gyi gar stabs su bzhugs pa'o// gzhung du/ phyogs kyi pad+ma 'dab bzhi la// 'byung bzhi bskyed pa'i sa bon las// rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro rnam bzhi bskyed// ces dang*/ zhal gdams kyi thog mar/ de'i shar du ha las rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog sngon mo/ lhor ri las rin chen mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog ser mo/ nub tu ni las pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog dmar mo/ byang du sa las las kyi mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog ljang khu/ de thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje dang*/ rin po che dang*/ pad+ma dang*/ ral gris mtshan pa'i gri gug bsnams pa/ g.yon pa rnams kyis thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams pa/ gru mo na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga yod pa/ rgyan cha lugs thams cad gtso mo dang mtshungs pa'o// gtso mo'i gsang gnas su chos 'byung gru gsum me'i dkyil 'khor lta bu'i dbus su yi ge hrīḥdamar po 'khor gyi mkha' 'gro ma bzhi'i thugs kar ha ri ni sa yi ge lnga las 'od zer 'phros pas/ o rgyan gyi gnas nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa la bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

hūm̐/ snang ba chos sku'i gzhal yas nas// rtsa ba'i bla ma gshegs su gsol// chos dbyings dag pa'i gzhal yas nas// bka' brgyud bla ma gshegs su gsol// chos sku spros bral dag pa la// longs sku sgyu ma'i skur bstan pa// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas rnal 'byor ma// phyag rgya chen po'i dbyings nas bzhengs// sems can don la dgongs mdzod la// skad cig tsam gyis gshegs su gsol// mi 'gyur gnas pa'i gzhal yas nas// rdo rje mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol// bde chen dag pa'i gzhal yas nas// sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol// gter 'byung yid bzhin gzhal yas nas// rin chen mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol// shes rab btsun mo'i bha ga nas// pad+ma mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol// mchod rten dkar po'i dpal grags nas// sna tshogs mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol// dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad nas// las kyi mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol// ro langs 'khrug pa'i dur khrod nas// 'jig rten mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol// steng 'og phyogs mtshams so so nas// chos skyong srung ma gshegs su gsol// oṃ e ā ra li hoḥbadz+ra wārā hī/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ bud+dhā ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra ḍā ki nī ye/ rat+na ḍā ki nī ye/ pad+ma ḍā ki nī ye/ karma ḍā ki nī ye/ bi shwo ḍā ki nī ye/ lo ka ḍā ki nī ye/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ dṛ sh+ya ho/ pheṃ pheṃ pheṃ/ bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs// bdag cag bsod nams skal par ldan// bdag gi mchod yon bzhes slad du// 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol// stong gsum kun dang mnyam pa yi// pad+ma 'dab brgyad ge sar bcas// bde zhing yangs par 'bul lags na// ci bder bar ni bzhugs su gsol// oṃ shrī badz+ra wārā hī pad+ma ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/ oṃ shrī badz+ra wārā hī badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/

shab+da āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra wārā hī/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra ḍā ki nī ye/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rat+na ḍā ki nī ye/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ pad+ma ḍā ki nī ye/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ karma ḍā ki nī ye/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bi shwa ḍā ki nī ye/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lo ka ḍā ki nī ye/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gyis nang mchod 'bul/ de rnams kyi sku las rje btsun ma gtso 'khor gyi sku dpag tu med pa byon/ spyi bor thim/ bde ba dang nus pa bskyed/ de rnams kyi gsung las sngags ā li kā li dkar po dang dmar po'i phreng ba byung*/ mgrin par thim/ mthu dang nus pa bskyed/ de rnams kyi thugs las byang chub sems kyi chu rgyun ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin byon/ snying gar thim/ bde stong gi ye shes rgyud la skyes/ lha mo de rnams rang rang gi sku la thim pas gnyis su med par gyur/ mdun bskyed la dmigs pa'i bzlas pa bya/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye ha ri ni sa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ mchod bzhi/ bstod bzhi ni/ e ma ho ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo nyid// 'khor 'das yon tan dpal dang ldan// bka' brgyud rin po che la phyag 'tshal bstod// bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos// bla ma dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang*// kun gyi byed pa bla ma yin// bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// hūm̐ dpal dang ldan pa'i bcom ldan 'das ma khyod// mkha' mnyam bde rol 'gro ba kun bdag mo// longs spyod sgyu ma'i gzugs dang chags pa'i mdangs// mkha' 'gro drwa ba sdom la phyag 'tshal lo// rnam dag mi g.yo chos kyi dbyings nyid las// lhan cig skyes pa'i bde ba stong pa'i zhal// 'gyur med bde ba stong pa'i gzugs 'dzin ma// rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal ba bdag po lnga yi phyag rgya can// rnam dag sku la mi bskyod rtags kyis mdzes// rigs drug 'khor los sgyur ba'i go char ldan// 'khor lo kun gyi yum la phyag 'tshal lo// khyod ni rnam dag phung po lnga ston zhing*// 'byung lnga rnam dag tshangs pa'i gnas bzhir ldan// bdud las thar mdzad sprul pa'i zhal mnga' ma// 'khor lo sdom pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// badz+ra wārā hī/

oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bud+dha ḍā ki nī= badz+ra ḍā ki nī= rat+na ḍā ki nī= pad+ma ḍā ki nī= karma ḍā ki nī= bi shwa ḍā ki nī= lo ka ḍā ki nī= sogs rol mo 'bul/ rgyal ba'i sku la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang*// sems can nyon mongs bag chags sbyang slad du// sku gsung thugs la khrus chab 'di gsol bas// khams gsum gnas pa'i dri ma dag gyur cig /oṃ shrī badz+ra wārā hī badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ dkyil 'khor kun tu rgyal ba mnyes gyur pa'i// lha rdzas dbyibs legs me tog dam pa 'di// nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis mngon sprul nas// gzhal yas khang du sprin bzhin btibs gyur cig /oṃ shrī badz+ra wārā hī badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs/ tshul khrims dri ldan spos mchog dam pa 'di// ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs nas// sangs rgyas zhing du spos dri ngad ldang bas// rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams mnyes gyur cig /dhū pe/ nyon mongs dug sreg ma rig mun sel ba'i// shes rab gzi ldan dpal gyi sgron me 'di// sprin med mkha' la nyi shar ji bzhin du// 'od zer snang bas phyogs bcur gsal gyur cig /ā lo ke// stong gsum kun tu dri dang ngad ldan pa'i// spos dang sman sbyar chu gtsang rgyal ba'i khrus// ye shes sprin phung thugs rje'i char rgyun gyis// mi gtsang dri ma'i tshogs rnams dag gyur cig /gan+dhe/ rgyal ba'i sku la bkres pa mi mnga' yang*// 'gro ba'i don du lha rdzas bdud rtsi'i bshos// dag cing gtsang mar bshams te 'bul lags na// bsod nams zhing gyur rnams kyis bzhes su gsol// nai wi d+ye/ dril chen sil snyan rnam grol tshangs pa'i dbyangs// bsam dag ngag gis bstod de gus mchod 'bul// sa bcu rim gyis bgrod nas sangs rgyas sar// tshogs gnyis rdzogs nas chos kyi rgyal por shog /shab+da/ badz+ra wārā hī/

oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gong bzhin 'gre'o// bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// stong nyid rdo rje ldan pa'i bdag nyid can// bskal pa'i me 'bar 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra sgrogs// rdo rje gtum mo de la phyag 'tshal lo// phag gdong rtog med chos sku 'gyur med ston// khro mo'i thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma// 'gro don rdzogs mdzad 'jigs pa'i cha lugs can// rtog med 'gro don mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jigs rung dpa' mo ma rungs tshar gcod ma// spyan gsum mche gtsigs sku gsum don dang ldan// nyon mongs gcod mdzad 'jigs pa'i nga ro can// bdud 'dul 'joms ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo// skra grol gcer bu skyon bral 'jigs pa'i gzugs// nyon mongs skyon bral sems can don mdzad ma// thugs rje'i lcags kyus 'gro drug gnas nas 'dren// phrin las rdzogs mdzad de la phyag 'tshal lo// dur khrod gnas bzhugs ru dra pho mo 'dul// drag mo 'jigs shul phaṭa kyi sgra sgrogs shing*// thabs mkhas thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma// bdud 'dul drag mo'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo// chos nyid don rtogs 'chi ba'i tshul spangs ma// ro dang nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan gyi tshul// rgyan rnams kun gyis rab mdzes khro mo'i sku// yon tan rdzogs mdzad de la phyag 'tshal lo// gri gug thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ phyag na bsnams// nyon mongs gcod mdzad ye shes 'od dang ldan// dug gsum gcod mdzad sku gsum lhun gyis grub// 'gro ba'i don mdzad de la phyag 'tshal lo// bde chen rang byung rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mi 'gyur ye shes rdo rje chos kyi sku// rtog med spros bral ye shes chos dbyings don// yang dag gnyis med sku la phyag 'tshal lo// lha mo drug gi rang bzhin rdo rje'i rigs// dpal 'bar 'jigs mdzad khro tshul 'gying bag can// bde chen rang byung phyag rgya chen mo'i don// nyon mongs dgrol mdzad de la phyag 'tshal lo// kun rdzob don dam rang bzhin phag mo ste// sku mdog dmar ba thugs rje'i rang 'od can// 'dod dgu phun tshogs rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// bde chen rang byung sku la phyag 'tshal lo// dur khrod rgyan rnams sku la rdzogs pa ste// gri gug kha ṭ+wāṃ phyag mtshan so sor bsnams// thugs rje'i rang bzhin skra grol thur du spungs// spyan dmar 'dzum zhal de la phyag 'tshal lo// phrin las grub pa rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// bde 'gro'i gnas su 'dren pa'i thugs rje can// skyon bral yang dag lha yi lhar gyur pa// rdo rje 'phrul mo che la phyag 'tshal lo// badz+ra wārā hī/

oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sogs 'gre'o// kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ong rgyan phreng ldan// phyogs dus kun na gzugs mchog ci mchis pa// mos blos rje btsun ma la bdag 'bul na// bzhes nas bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// oṃ shrī badz+ra wārā hī badz+ra rū pa pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ phyogs dus kun na zin dang ma zin pa'i// yon tan tshig brjod sgra snyan yid 'ong ldan// mos blos rje btsun ma la bdag 'bul na// bzhes nas bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// shab+da sogs/ phyogs dus kun na tsan dan sbrul snying dang*// a gar la sogs dbang po tshim byed dri// mos blos rje btsun ma la bdag 'bul na// bzhes nas bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// gan+dhe/ phyogs dus kun na ro dang bcud ldan pa'i// lus sems brtas byed ro mchog ci mchis pa// mos blos rje btsun ma la bdag 'bul na// bzhes nas bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// rā sa/ phyogs dus kun na 'jam mnyen 'khril chags pa'i// reg bya'i khyad par 'phags pa ci mchis pa// mos blos rje btsun ma la bdag 'bul na// bzhes nas bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// spar+she/ badz+ra wārā hī/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sogs/ hūm̐/ lte ba'i dbus gnas rnal 'byor ma// zhe sdang gcod mdzad grub pa mo// me long ye shes ngo bo nyid// rdo rje phag mor phyag 'tshal bstod// me dpung 'bar ba'i lte ba la// sku gsung thugs dang ye shes lnga// zag med bde ba ster mdzad ma// sangs rgyas yum la phyag 'tshal bstod// dhū tī'i 'od kyi rang bzhin ma// dbugs bral lte ba nyid la bzhugs// zhu ba'i rang bzhin bde chen ma// bde gter yum la phyag 'tshal bstod// dngos po gshis kyi don ston ma// sku bzhi dbyer maid gnyug ma'i ngang*// bde ba chen po'i ngo bo nyid// rdo rje mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// bde chen lam sna 'dren pa'i yum// du ma ro gcig don ston ma// snang stong dbyer med ngo bo nyid// rin chen mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// bdud bzhi'i dmag las rab rgyal zhing*// bde chen byin gyis brlabs mdzad ma// rtsa rlung thig le'i ngo bo nyid// pad+ma mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// bdud dang log 'dren zhi mdzad ma// bar chad srung zhing byin brlabs can// mthu dang rdzu 'phrul ngo bo nyid// las kyi mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// mchog dang thun mong la sogs pa// dbang bzhi bskur bar mdzad du gsaul// rgyud bzhi smin par byin gyis rlobs// phrin las rnam bzhi'i dngos grub stsol// badz+ra wārā hī/

oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sogs/ sha chen gsur gyi bdug spos dang*// zhun chen gsal ba'i mar me dang*// byang sems dkar dmar bdud rtsi dang*// rdo rje dri chen zhal zas dang*// rdo rje dri chu'i bdud rtsi dang*// ḍā ma ru yi sil snyan gyis// pha rol phyin drug lha mo mchod// sa bcu non phyir bzhes su gsol// badz+ra wārā hī/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sogs/ hūm̐/ rdo rje phag mo bde gshegs yum// 'dod pa'i dbang phyug skal ldan ma// mkha' 'gro chen mo rnal 'byor gtso// rdo rje dbyings kyi khro rgyal yum// phyag rgya chen mo rdo rje'i sku// he ru ka dpal yang dag sbyor// dbu stong ma la spyan stong ma// stong phrag bcu yi zhal gdong can// khro gnyer mche ba rab tu gtsigs// nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid can// spyan mig dmar ser glog ltar 'khyug /dbu skra gyen brdzes thog ser 'bebs// seng ge'i gzugs can 'dab bzang gzugs// glang po'i rgyal po che ba'i gzugs// 'jig rten gsum gyi lto ba can// rgya mtsho mtha' dag ska rags can// thod pa dang ni kha ṭ+wāṃ 'dzin// rdo rje zangs gris gdug pa 'joms// mi rus phreng ba'i rgyan cha dang*// mi mgo rlon pa'i do shal can// bde gshegs 'bum ni khyod kyi 'khor// che ba'i lha rnams khyod kyi bran// rig pa'i rgyal mo 'dod gzugs can// rnal 'byor che ba'i dngos grub 'bebs// dpal chen dngos grub mchog stsol ba'i// hūm̐ dang phaṭa kyi 'brug sgra can// khro mo'i gzugs can khams gsum 'joms// rgya mtsho'i 'jing rnams skems par mdzad// sna tshogs pad nyi nges gnon zhing*// srid pa gsum po za bar byed// zas su ma hā māṃ sa gsol// ma hā rak+ta 'thung bar byed// ma rungs gdug pa skrag mdzad cing*// rmongs dang rengs dang skrod mdzad ma// 'jigs par mdzad cing gsod par mdzad// ngo mtshar 'dod pa'i gzugs mnga' ma// yid 'ong dngos grub mchog stsol ba'i// phag mo khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// bdag gis khyod la gang gsol ba'i// don de deng 'dir stsal du gsol// dbang bzhi bskur bar mdzad du gsol// rgyud bzhi smin par byin gyis rlobs// phrin las rnam bzhi'i dngos grub stsol// badz+ra wārā hī/

oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sogs/ chang sna bzhi yi chang phud la// sa bcu non phyir lag mchod byas// shes rab g.yon gyi lag pa la// thabs chen g.yas kyi lag pas mchod// mtshan ldan rdo rje ka pā la// ka ni gang du'ang mi gnas shing*// pā ni ma skyes skye ba med// la ni blo 'das yid dang bral// sku gsum mi 'gyur ka pā lar// zag med bde ba'i chang phud gtams// skye 'chi med pa'i bdud rtsi blug /yi ge gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs// oṃ gyis skye med sprul skur sbyangs// āḥyis 'gag med longs skur bsgyur// hūm̐ gis blo 'das chos skur spel// lan gsum dkrugs pa'i bdud rtsi 'dis// pha rol phyin drug lha mo mchod// mnyam nyid dbyings su bzhes su gsol// badz+ra wārā hī/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sogs gong bzhin 'gre/ byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba bka' brgyud bla ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dngos grub kyi rtsa ba yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ phrin las kyi rtsa ba chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang 'gro ba rigs drug lam rgyud lnga skye gnas rnam pa bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad yi dam gyi lhar gsal ba'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// ༈ //bdag 'jug dang slob ma gzhug pa'i cho ga ni/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis khrus bgyi'o// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka tā sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ khrus bya/ sa gzhi spos chus byugs shing me tog bkram// ri rab gling bzhi nyi zlas brgyan pa 'di// sangs rgyas zhing du dmigs te phul ba yis// 'gro kun rnam dag zhing du spyod par shog /maṇ+ḍal phul/ bdag ni 'khor ba'i chos la skyo ba skyes// 'jig rten bya ba thams cad spangs nas ni// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog 'jug 'dod na// dam pas bdag ni nges par gzhug tu gsol// zhes pa'am/

slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol// dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste// byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa// mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo// dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsaul// byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol// zhes gsol ba btab la/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa'i cho ga rgyas par bya'o// yang na bsdus pa tsam bya ste/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// byang chub sems su 'di bgyid de// bdag dang gzhan don rab bsgrub phyir// bdag gis byang chub sems mchog bskyed// e ma ho sems can kun mgron gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog mdzad bzhin spyad// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas shog /slob ma/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las slob ma rnams rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ phyag g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug dang*/ g.yon pas thod pa bdud rtsis bkang ba bsnams pa/ gru mo na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga yod pa/ rgyan cha lugs thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i skur gyur/ dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying gar dri'i chus byugs la/ rdo rjes reg cing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dpral bar oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ mgrin par āḥlas pad+ma dmar po āḥs mtshan pa/ snying gar hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gyis mtshan pa/ de dag gi 'od zer gyis lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib bsal nas sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs par sgoms shig

/puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐ gyis mchod/ gnas rnams su rdo rje bsdams pa'i gung mo gnyis gshibs te brkyang pa rdo rje'i phyag rgyas reg la/ lte bar phag mo'i ngo bo oṃ bam̐ dmar mo/ snying gar gshin rje ma'i ngo bo haṃ yaṃ sngon mo/ kha la rmongs byed ma'i ngo bo hrīṃ mam̐ dkar mo/ mgo bor bskyod byed ma'i ngo bo hrīṃ hrīṃ ser mo/ spyi gtsug tu skrag byed ma'i ngo bo hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang khu/ smin mtshams su gtum mo'i ngo bo phaṭa phaṭa dud kha ste/ go cha'i dpa' mo drug gis bsrung ba'o// yang na gsol ba gdab pa nas 'di'i bar mdun bskyed kyi gong du byas kyang rung ngo*// sa gzhi spos sogs maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// slob dpon la ni skyabs su mchi// bcom ldan rdo rje rnal 'byor mas// bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol// slob dpon gyis/ bla ma dang ni yi dam lha// tha dad du ni ma blta zhig /nges par dngos grub dam pa 'di// bdag gis khyod la sbyin par bya// oṃ tsak+ṣu bhan+dha wār mā ṇa ye hūm̐ gyis gdong dar bcing*/ oṃ ā khaṃ bī ra hūm̐ gyis me tog gi phreng ba lag tu gtang*/ sngar gyi gtor chog ltar gtor ma btang ba ni/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dhonya haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can chang zung la yaṃ dang*/ mchog ma gnyis la g.yo ba'i ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po raṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du kaṃ gsum las thod pa bum ril gyi sgyed bu ltag pa nang du bstan pa gsum gyi steng du/ yi ge a yongs su gyur pa las ka pā la phyi dkar la nang dmar ba dum bu gcig pa dpral ba rang la bstan pa/ rgya khyon chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa/

de'i dbus su mu las dri chu bai ḍūr+ya lta bu/ shar du bi las dri chen shel lta bu/ lhor ra las rak+ta gser btso ma lta bu/ nub tu shu las byang sems dkar po/ byang du ma las klad pa slar yang dbus su na las mi'i sha shar lhor go las ba lang gi sha /lho nub tu ku las khyi'i sha /nub byang du da las glang po che'i sha /byang shar du ha las rta'i sha /de rnams slar yang yi ge de dag gis mtshan pa'o// rang gi sna bug g.yon pa nas rlung hūm̐ gi dbyibs can 'phros/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor la phog /ba dan bskyod pas rlung g.yos me sbar thod pa dros/ rdzas rnams khol/ nyes pa'i skyon rnams phyir lud/ de'i steng du oṃ āḥhūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug /dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang gnyis su med par 'dres/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis rlabs/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral bar bskor zhing*/ pheṃ pheṃ pheṃ/ zhes gtor mgron spyan drangs/ pad bskor rdo rje thal mo kha phye bas/ oṃ badz+ra ā ra li hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ki ni sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ dṛ sh+ya hoḥ zhes pa lan gsum mam bzhi'am lngar brjod/ so so'i phyag rgyas/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shab+da āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ pad bskor rdo rje thal mo kha phye bas/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba yak+ṣa rak+ṣa sa bhū ta pre ta pi sha tsa un+ma da a pa sma ra ḍā ka ḍā ki n+yā dā ya/ i dam ba liṃ gṛh+nan+tu sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu ma ma sarba sid+dhi m+me pra ya ts+tshan+tu ya thai baṃ ya thaiṣ+ṭaṃḥbhūñdza tha dzi gh+ra tha pi ba tha ma ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba kā ra ta ya sa ta su khaṃ bi shud+dha ye/ sa hā yi ka bha wan+tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ lan bzhi brjod/ zhing skyong chen po brgyad rnams dang*// sogs nas/

yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod// gang dag nag po'i phyogs gyur zhing*// gsang sngags zab mo'i cho ga la// nyan dang lta bar mi dbang ba// de dag thams cad gzhan du gdengs// gal te bka' las 'da' byed na// rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ rab 'bar bas// mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas 'gyur// gtor ma phyi rol du dor zhing*/ oṃ sum+bha ni sogs/ 'og thams cad rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ bar thams cad rdo rje'i ra ba/ steng thams cad rdo rje'i dra ba dang*/ gur bla bres su gyur/ hūm̐ 'di ltar lha mo ya mtshan can// lha mo'i lus la seng gdong ma// badz+ra singha zhes bya ba// steng sgo srung ba'i phra men ma// dzaḥphra men rdo rje'i dus la bab// steng gi bar chad zlog tu gsol// hūm̐ 'di ltar lha= lha mo'i lus la khwa gdong ma// badz+ra kā ka= shar sgo= dzaḥphra men= shar gyi= hūm̐ 'di ltar= lha mo'i lus la 'ug gdong ma// badz+ra ul+lu= byang sgo= dzaḥphra men= byang gi= hūm̐ 'di ltar= lha mo'i lus la khyi gdong ma// badz+ra shwa na= nub sgo= dza phra men= nub kyi= hūm̐ 'di ltar= lha mo'i lus la phag gdong ma// badz+ra su ka= lho sgo= dzaḥphra men= lho yi= hūm̐ 'di ltar= lha mo'i lus la stag gdong ma// badz+ra bya gh+ri= 'og sgo= dzaḥphra men= 'og gi= hūm̐ 'di ltar lha mo ya mtshan can// sgo ma rnams kyis sgo srungs la// mtshams ma rnams kyis mtshams sdoms shig /phyi nang bar chad zlog tu gsol// oṃ badz+ra bā rā hi hrīḥgha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ gnod byed sarba duṣ+ṭān hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ mtshams bcad do// snying gar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'od zer dang bcas pa/ slob mas/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pā dā yā mi/ snying gar rdo rje bzhag la/ oṃ su ra te sa ma ya s+t+waṃ hoḥsid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ thams cad rdo rje'i rang bzhin du sems bskyed pa de brtan par byas so// sdom pa gzung ba ni/

mgon po sangs rgyas rnams dang ni// sras bcas bdag la dgongs su gsol// rig pa 'dzin pa bdag gis ni// byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i// byang chub sems ni bla med pa// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// bdag gis brtan por gzung bar bgyi// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa// sdom pa deng nas brtan por gzung*// rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la// rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang*// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung ba'i// pad+ma'i rigs mchog dag pa la// phyi nang gsang ba'i theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos ni gzung bar bgyi// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// byang chub sems ni bla med pa// dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus gzung*// ma brgal ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol// dbugs ma phyung rnams dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god// mgo bor rdo rje bzhag la/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma rigs skyes// nga yis ye shes rdo rje sbyin// byin pas dngos grub thob par 'gyur// gang zhig 'di 'dra ma mthong ba'i// mdun du smra bar ma byed cig /gal te smras na nyams par 'gyur// de bas nga rgyal bcom nas ni// bdag nyid ma 'khrul shes par gyis// rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma khyod deng*// khyod kyi snying la yang dag zhugs// gal te tshul 'di smras na ni// de ma thag tu dral te gshegs// bdud rtsi lce la/

'di ni khyod kyi dam tshig chu// dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed// dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ni// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub// oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī a mṛ to da ka ṭha/ thal mo mgor/ dus 'di nas ni bu khyod kyi// rdo rje 'dzin pa nga yin gyi// nga yis ji ltar bka' stsal pa// khyod kyis skyo ba med par sgrubs// gang yang nga la ma gus min// de bzhin gus par ma byas na// bdud kyis bcom nas ngan 'gror 'gro// de bas dam tshig gnas par gyis// bdud rtsi lngas byugs pa'i maṇ+ḍal chos 'byung pad+ma me tog gi tshom bu bkod/ slob ma'i grangs dang mnyam pa la/ slob ma rnams bzhag la/ slob mas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ bdag dus 'di nas gzung ste byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku'i ngo bor gyur pa bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po dang*/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku la skyabs su mchi'o// bdag dus 'di nas gzung ste byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung gi ngo bor gyur pa bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po dang*/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gsung la skyabs su mchi'o// bdag dus 'di nas gzung ste byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kyi ngo bor gyur pa bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po dang*/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i thugs la skyabs su mchi'o// bla ma rdo rje 'dzin po chen po dang rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi sku gsung thugs kyi ye shes bdag la myur du dbab par mdzad du gsol/ de bzhin nyid kyi ye shes/ nam mkha' lta bu/ nor bu lta bu/ bdud rtsi lta bus gang bar mdzad du gsol/ smin par mdzad du gsol// shin tu smin par mdzad du gsol/

slob ma skyil krung phyed pas langs te spyi bor chos 'byung gi phyag rgya byed du bcug la/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag po gzhu'i dbyibs can/ de'i steng du skad cig gis khyed rang rnams rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gsal ba'i lte bar me rab tu 'bar ba'i chos 'byung dmar po'i dbus na hrīḥlas sngags phreng g.yon du drag tu 'khor ba de las 'od zer 'phros pas rdul tshon nam ras bris sam me long dang o rgyan nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sangs rgyas byang sems dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ sngags 'khor dang khyed rang rnams la thim/ gu gul dang tshil chen sregs ḍā ma ru'i sgra 'khrol zhing*/ slar yang sngags 'khor las 'od zer dang dga' 'khyil 'phros/ smin mtshams su g.yon du drag tu 'khor/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i byang sems spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang ba'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye ha ri ni sa ā be sha ya ā be sha ya/ a āḥhrīḥhrīḥpheṃ pheṃ pheṃ/ ltos shig rang gi sems la ltos// sems nyid cir yang grub pa med// grub pa med pa'i sems nyid 'di// sna tshogs snang ba ngo mtshar che// snang tsam nyid nas sems su 'dus// sems can kun gyi sems nyid de// bde ba chen po'i ye shes yin// rnam par mi rtog bsam mi khyab// gsal ba de yi ngo bor snang*// mos pa du ma'i sems can la// thabs rnams sna tshogs bstan pa ste// sna tshogs sgyu ma'i sbyor ba yis// dpa' bo seng ge bzhin du spyod// bsam gyis mi khyab go 'phang 'thob// rje btsun ma yi byin brlabs yin// bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa ni// sna tshogs nor bu ji bzhin du// skal ldan rnams kyi spyod yul yin// zhes ngo sprad de spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes brtan par bya'o// dkyil 'khor kha dog brtag /rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor 'dir// bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bya// mkha' 'gro'i rigs kyi rim pa bzhin// bsod nams gang yin de bzhin shog

/'dis ni dngos grub gang thob pa// rigs ni gang gi snod du 'gyur// 'di la bsod nams ci yod pa// dkyil 'khor 'dir ni de bzhin shog /badz+ra ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ bcom ldan 'das ma khyod kyis ni// 'di ni rjes su gzung bar mdzod// me tog gtad la lha bstim/ spyan lnga rnam dag dbye dang mi dbye bral// 'on kyang sna tshogs yangs pa'i spyan phye bas// chos kun sgrib bral mkhyen cing gzigs pa yi// sangs rgyas ye shes spyan ni thob gyur cig /zhes pa tsam dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ne tra a pa ha ra ba ṭa laṃ hrīḥ gser gyi thur mas gdong g.yogs bsal te/ dkyil 'khor gnyan po 'di la ltos// da ni dad pa rab tu bskyed// khyod ni rnal 'byor ma rigs skyes// sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis rlobs// 'gro ba phun tshogs dngos grub kun// dngos grub thams cad 'di las byung*// dam tshig thams cad bskyang ba dang*// gsang sngags 'di la brtson par gyis// zhes lha ngo bstan nas sa gzhi spos chus sogs maṇ+ḍal phul/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po dang*/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi sku gsung thugs zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis dbang bskur du gsol/ lha mo dpal gyi blo gros kyis// bir wa pa la dbang bskur ltar// de bzhin bla ma khyod kyis kyang*// bdag sogs dbang bskur mdzad du gsol// rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rnams la// mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar// bdag kyang rab tu bsgrub slad du// dbang bskur dam pa bdag la stsol// slob dpon gyi lte ba'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi phyag na ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin bdud rtsi byang sems kyis bkang ba'i bum pa dang thod pa bzung ba rnams spyan drangs/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ slob ma la dbang bskur bar mdzad du gsol/

slob ma'i spyi bor bum pa bzhag la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi bum pa'i dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// sangs rgyas kun tu rab bsgrub phyir// bum pa'i dbang ni khyod la bskur// ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ye shrī hūm̐/ rdo rje lag tu gtad cing*/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro zhe sdang rnam dag pa// rnam shes gnas gyur me long ye shes kyi// rang bzhin mi g.yo mchog gi dbang bskur bas// bde gshegs kun gyi thugs su grol gyur cig /ha oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ye shrī hūm̐/ dbang gi lha rnams slob ma'i lus la zhugs te/ bum chus gtor zhing bkrus la blug /dri ma phung po nyon mongs dag /sku dang ye shes dbang rnams thob// mgo bor chu las mi bskyod pa'o// slob dpon gyi lte ba'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi phyag na ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin dbu rgyan dang dar dpyangs bzung ba rnams spyan drangs/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ slob ma la dbang bskur bar mdzad du gsol/ sangs rgyas kun gyi dbu rgyan dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// sangs rgyas kun tu rab bsgrub phyir// dbu rgyan dbang ni khyod la bskur// ji ltar bltams pa sogs/ shrī hūm̐ bar brjod/ rin po che lag tu gtad cing*/ rin chen mkha' 'gro nga rgyal rnam dag pa// tshor ba gnas gyur mnyam nyid ye shes kyi// rang bzhin mi g.yo mchog gi dbang bskur bas// bde gshegs kun gyi yon tan rdzogs gyur cig /ri oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ye shrī hūm̐/ dbang gi lha rnams slob ma'i lus la zhugs te/ bum chus gtor zhing bkrus la blug

/dri ma phung po nyon mongs dag /sku dang ye shes dbang rnams thob// mgo bor chu las rin 'byung ngo*// slob dpon gyi lte ba'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi phyag na ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin rtse mo dgu pa'i rdo rje bzung ba rnams spyan drangs/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ slob ma la dbang bskur bar mdzad du gsol/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// sangs rgyas kun tu rab bsgrub phyir// rdo rje'i dbang ni khyod la bskur// ji ltar bltams pa sogs/ shrī hūm̐ bar brjod/ pad+ma lag tu gtad de/ pad+ma mkha' 'gro 'dod chags rnam dag pa// 'du shes gnas gyur sor rtog ye shes kyi// rang bzhin mi g.yo mchog gi dbang bskur bas// bdai gshegs kun gyi gsung du 'grub gyur cig /ni oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ye shrī hūm̐/ dbang gi lha rnams slob ma'i lus la zhugs te/ bum chus gtor zhing bkrus la blug /dri ma phung po nyon mogs dag /sku dang ye shes dbang rnams thob// mgo bor chu las 'od dpag med// slob dpon gyi lte ba'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi phyag na ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin sgra grags bzhin pa'i dril bu bzung ba rnams spyan drangs/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ slob ma la dbang bskur bar mdzad du gsol/ sangs rgyas kun gyi dril bu'i dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// sangs rgyas kun tu rab bsgrub phyir// dril bu'i dbang ni khyod la bskur// ji ltar bltams pa sogs/ shrī hūm̐ bar brjod/ ral gri lag tu gtad de/ las kyi mkha' 'gro phrag dog rnam dag pa// 'du byed gnas gyur bya grub ye shes kyi// rang bzhin mi g.yo mchog gi dbang bskur bas// bde gshegs kun gyi phrin las rdzogs gyur cig

/sa oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ye shrī hūm̐/ dbang gi lha rnams slob ma'ilus la zhugs te/ bum chus gtor zhing bkrus la blug /dri ma phung po nyon mongs dag /sku dang ye shes dbang rnams thob// mgo bor chu las don grub bo// slob dpon gyi lte ba'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sangs rgyas byang sems rnams spyan drangs/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ slob ma la dbang bskur du gsol/ mgo thog tu rdo rje dril bu mnyam por bzung la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ming gi dbang*/ de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// sangs rgyas kun tu rab bsgrub phyir// ming gi dbang ni khyod la bskur// kyai dpal snang mdzad rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o// ji ltar bltams pa sogs/ shrī hūm̐ bar brjod/ gri gug lag tu gtad la/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro gti mug rnam dag pa// gzugs phung gnas gyur chos dbyings ye shes kyi// rang bzh-in mi g.yo mchog gi dbang bskur bas// bde gshegs kun gyi skur ni 'grub gyur cig /hrī oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ye shrī hūm̐/ dbang gi lha rnams slob ma'i lus la zhugs te/ bum chus gtor zhing bkrus la blug /dri ma phung po nyon mongs dag /sku dang ye shes dbang rnams thob/ mgo bor chu las rnam snang ngo*// de ltar rdul tshon nam ras bris sam me long gi dkyil 'khor la brten nas rig pa'i dbang lnga ste/ lus la bum pa'i dbang bskur bas lus kyi sgrib pa dag nas lam bskyed pa'i rim pa snang stong dbyer med bsgom pa la dbang zhing*/ 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku 'grub pa'i skal pa dang ldan par byas so// bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i snyoms 'jug gi sgras/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs/ zhal nas zhugs/ thugs kar zhu/

sbyor mtshams nas babs pa'i bdud rtsi dang*/ sngar nas dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i byang sems thod par gnas pas spyi bor dbang bskur zhing*/ thod pa spyi bor dang mgrin par bzhag la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi thod pa'i dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// sangs rgyas kun tu rab bsgrub phyir// gsang ba'i dbang ni khyod la bskur// oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ thod pa'i bdud rtsi 'thung du gzhug /byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsi de rtsa 'khor lo bzhi la brgyud/ lus kyi rtsa gnas thams cad du bde ba chen pos khyab par sgoms shig /de ltar bla ma yab yum gyi lus dkyil la brten nas ngag la gsang ba'i dbang bskur bas ngag gi sgrib pa dag nas/ lam rtsa rlung thig le rdzogs pa'i rim pa sgyu lus gsal stong dbyer med sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku 'grub pa'i skal pa dang ldan par byas so// de nas sin dhū ra'i me long slob ma'i lte bar bzhag cing*/ sangs rgyas kun gyi me long dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// sangs rgyas kun tu rab bsgrub phyir// shes rab ye shes dbang ni khyod la bskur// o+oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ye shrī hūm̐/ me long gi dkyil 'khor las rdo rje rnal 'byor ma 'phros/ slob ma'i lte bar zhugs/ rlung gzung bas/ dkyil 'khor de las dmar cha shes rab ye shes kyi me 'bar bas spyi bo'i haṃ yig zhu nas rtsa 'khor lo bzhi la brgyud/ lhan cig skyes dga'i ye shes nyams su myong ba'i mos pa mdzod/ de ltar sin dhū ra'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas sems la shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur bas sems kyi sgrib pa dag nas lam dga' bzhi'i ye shes 'od gsal bde stong dbyer med bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos kyi sku 'grub pa'i skal pa dang ldan par byas so// phyag rgya chen po'i gnas mchog na/

byang chub sems dpa' spyod pa'i blo gros bzhugs/ de ni ming tsam brda' tsam btags pa tsam/ de ltar chos thams cad dngos po de nyid du ma grub/ khyed rang gi sems nyid gzhi med rtsa bral spros pa'i mtha' dang bral ba'o// sna tshogs su snang yang snang sems gnyis med chos kyi sku ngos gzung med par ngo shes par gyis shig /de ltar snang srid phyag rgya chen po'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas lus ngag yid gsum la bzhi pa'i dbang bskur bas sgo gsum gyi sgrib pa mtha' dag dag /lam 'od gsal zung 'jug rig stong dbyer med phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sku gsum dbyer med dam ngo bo nyid kyi sku 'grub pa'i skal pa dang ldan par byas so// byin brlabs bsdus pa de tsam mam/ yang spro na slob mas/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen pos bdag la rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang dang rjes gnang stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab nas/ slob ma rnams pad nyi la hūm̐ dang rdo rje las rdo rje 'chang dang rdo rje snyems ma sku mdog sngon mo rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin par gyur/ bum pa'i dbang bskur te/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa// sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi// gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ dbang gi lha rnams ye shes pa'i tshul du zhugs shing spyi bor mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ me tog gtor zhing*/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra swāhā/ rdo rje lag pa g.yas su gtad la/ hūm̐ las skyes pa'i rdo rje thabs de kho na nyid kyi rdo rje thugs kyi dam tshig zungs shig /dril bu g.yon du sbyin la/ āḥlas byung ba'i dril bu shes rab de kho na nyid kyi dril bu gsung gi dam tshig zungs shig /'khyud pa'i tshul byed du bcug la/ 'khyud pas yum dang bcas pa sbyor ba kha sbyor gyi rim pas phyag rgya sku'i dam tshig zungs shig

/yang rdo rje dril bu gtad de/ rdo rje dang ni dril bu longs// shes rab lag pas yang dag 'khyud// rdo rje dril bu mnyam par sbyor// de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur// 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang thob pa yin no// dbang bskur ba dang rab tu gnas pa dang slob ma bsdu bar gyis shig /dam tshig gsum sngon du 'gro ba rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang ngo*// spyi bor sin dhū ra byugs la/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang spyi gtsug tu mi 'bral bar sgoms shig /lte bar byugs shing*/ khyod kyi lha rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yin pas rtag tu mi 'bral bar lus sems rdo rje rnal 'byor mar sgoms shig /phreng ba gtad la/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye ha ri ni sa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ sngags rnams rjes zlos byed du gzhug /mgrin par byugs la/ bzlas pa'i rim pa rnams dang ma bral bar gyis shig /sku gsung thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba'o// dam tshig dang mchod pa dang*/ brtul zhugs dang*/ las bzhi'i rjes su gnang ba yang sbyin te/ rigs lnga mkha' 'gro'i phyi nang gi /rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig rnams// khyod kyis legs par bsrung bar gyis// zhes pa tsam mam/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro'i dam tshig tu// bla ma la gus spyi bor bkur// sems can rnams la byams pa bsgom// rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i dam tshig tu// sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga la spyad// rnam par mi rtog ting 'dzin bsgom// pad+ma mkha' 'gro'i dam tshig tu// phyag rgya bsten zhing bde ba bsgom// me mchod 'bul zhing glu gar bya// las kyi mkha' 'gro'i dam tshig tu// rgyud la gang skyes shes pa rnams// mi dgag thad kar spyod par bya// rin chen mkha' 'gro'i dam tshig tu// tshogs dang gtor ma rgya chen bya// chags zhen spangs la ri khrod 'grim// phyi nang gsang ba de kho na'i// mchod pa du mas yang dag mchod// ya nga mi bya tshad gzung med// rig pa ngar dang bcas pa yis// mi phod brdzi zhing zhen pa zlog
