/'khri ba btsan thabs dag tu bcad// brtul zhugs thug phrad lam du khyer// gcer bu stag gi sham thabs bya// phyag rgya lngas brgyan cang te'u dang*// dril bu sil sil tshangs skud dang*// thod pa dang ni kha ṭ+wāṃ thogs// dur khrod kun tu rgyu bya ste// rig pa brtul zhugs spyod pa gyis// bsrung ba sbyin sreg phyir zlog sogs// phrin las rab 'byams sgrub par byos// gtso bos ji ltar sogs/ zhes bsgos la/ slob mas bka' drin gyi yon du/ sa gzhi spos chus sogs maṇ+ḍal 'bul lo// deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du// khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags kyi// khyed kyis slob mar bzung ba dang*// cha shas kyang ni spyad du gsol// slob ma rjes su 'dzin pa'i cho ga'o// ༈ //tshogs rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharma swa bha wa shud+dhonyahaṃ/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can chang zung la yaṃ dang*/ mchog ma gnyis la g.yo ba'i ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po raṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du kaṃ gsum las thod pa bum ril gyi sgyed bu ltag pa nang du bstan pa gsum gyi steng du/ yi ge a yongs su gyur pa las ka pā la phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ dum bu gcig pa dpral ba rang la bstan pa/ rgya khyon chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa/ de'i dbus su mu las dri chu baiḍūr+ya lta bu/ shar du bi las dri chen shel lta bu/ lhor ra las rak+ta gser btso ma lta bu/ nub tu shu las byang sems dkar po/ byang du ma las klad pa/ slar yang dbus su na las mi'i sha /shar lhor go las ba lang gi sha /lho nub tu ku las khyi'i sha /nub byang du da las glang po che'i sha /byang shar du ha las rta'i sha /de rnams slar yang yi ge de dag gis mtshan pa'o// rang gi sna bug g.yon pa nas rlung hūm̐ gi dbyibs can 'phros/

rlung gi dkyil 'khor la phog /ba dan bskyod pas rlung g.yos me sbar thod pa dros/ rdzas rnams khol/ nyes pa'i skyon rnams phyir lud/ de'i steng du oṃ āḥhūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug /dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang gnyis su med par 'dres/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥham̐'u/ lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlabs te/ na mo thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po 'di/ rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa skye ba med pa/ ngo bo rnam par dag pa ā li kā li/ mtshan nyid rnam par dag pa sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas rgyas btab pa 'di/ bsngo zhing 'bul ba'i gnas su gyur pa ni/ byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba bka' brgyud bla ma rnams kyi zhal du khā hi/ dngos grub kyi rtsa ba yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du khā hi/ phrin las kyi rtsa ba chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi zhal du khā hi/ pañtsa a mṛ ta la khā hi/ ga ṇa tsakra la khā hi/ hūm̐ bzhengs shig bla ma rnams bzhengs shig /bka' brgyud bla ma sku bskyod 'tshal// rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi dbus// 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes// dbu la thor tshugs rgyan gyis brgyan/ gser gyi cod pan ldems se ldems// rin chen snyan cha khra la la// phyag gdub zhabs gdub si li li// dar gyi cod pan pu ru ru// glu len gar byed khyugs se khyugs// sil snyan mang po dkrol zhing byon// 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes// gnas khang 'di la byin gyis rlobs// tshogs gtor 'di la bcud cig phob// 'dir tshogs rnal 'byor thams cad la// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol// oṃ na mo gu ru a dhiṣ+ṭha na pañtsa a mṛ ta la khā hi/ ga ṇa tsakra la khā hi/ hūm̐ bzhengs shig yi dam rnams bzhengs shig /rdo rje phag mo sku bskyod 'tshal// o rgyan gnas nas gshegs su gsol// 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes// dbu la thor tshugs sogs gong bzhin 'gre'o// oṃ shrī badz+ra wār hi pañtsa a mṛ ta la khā hi/

ga ṇa tsakra la khā hi/ hūm̐ bzhengs shig mkha' 'gro rnams bzhengs shig /rdo rje mkha' 'gro sku bskyod 'tshal// mi 'gyur gnas nas gshegs su gsol// 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes// dbu la thor tshugs sogs/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī ye pañtsa a mṛ ta la khā hi/ ga ṇa tsakra la khā hi/ hūm̐ bzhengs shig mkha' 'gro rnams bzhengs shig /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro sku bskyod 'tshal// bde chen gnas nas gshegs su gsol// 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes// dbu la thor tshugs sogs/ oṃ bud+dhā ḍā ki nī ye pañtsa a mṛ ta la khā hi/ ga ṇa tsakra la khā hi/ hūm̐ bzhengs shig mkha' 'gro rnams bzhengs shig /rin chen mkha' 'gro sku bskyod 'tshal// gter 'byung yid bzhin gnas nas bzhengs// 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes// dbu la thor tshugs sogs/ oṃ rat+na ḍā ki nī ye pañtsa a mṛ ta la khā hi/ ga ṇa tsakra la khā hi/ hūm̐ bzhengs shig mkha' 'gro rnams bzhengs shig /pad+ma mkha' 'gro sku bskyod 'tshal// rang byung bde chen gnas nas bzhengs// 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes// dbu la thor tshugs sogs/ oṃ pad+ma ḍā ki nī ye pañtsa a mṛ ta la khā hi/ ga ṇa tsakra la khā hi/ hūm̐ bzhengs shig mkha' 'gro rnams bzhengs shig /sna tshogs mkha' 'gro sku bskyod 'tshal// mchod rten dkar po gnas nas bzhengs// 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes// dbu la thor tshugs sogs/ oṃ bi shwa ḍā ki nī ye pañtsa a mṛ ta la khā hi/ ga ṇa tsakra la khā hi/ hūm̐ bzhengs shig mkha' 'gro rnams bzhengs shig /las kyi mkha' 'gro sku bskyod 'tshal// dur khrod gnas nas gshegs su gsol// 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes// dbu la thor tshugs sogs/ oṃ karma ḍā ki nī ye pañtsa a mṛ ta la khā hi/ ga ṇa tsakra la khā hi/ hūm̐ bzhengs shig mkha' 'gro rnams bzhengs shig /'jig rten mkha' 'gro sku bskyod 'tshal// dam tshig gnas nas gshegs su gsol// 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes// gzi brjid bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar// rgyan dang cha lugs ldan pa yi// so so'i rigs kyi 'khor gyis bskor// dur khrod nyul zhing rnal 'byor skyong*// 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes// phyi nang bar chad zhi ba dang*// phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub tu gsol// oṃ lo ka ḍā ki nī ye pañtsa a mṛ ta la khā hi/

ga ṇa tsakra la khā hi/ hūm̐ bzhengs shig chos skyong rnams bzhengs shig /ma mgon lcam dral sku bskyod 'tshal// phyogs mtshams kun nas gshegs su gsol// 'jigs pa'i gad mo hūm̐ sgra can// bstan pa bsrung zhing rnal 'byor skyong*// 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes// sgrub la bar du gcod pa yi// dgra bgegs ma lus zhi bar mdzod// oṃ ma hā kā lā ya pañtsa a mṛ ta la khā hi/ ga ṇa tsakra la khā hi/ hūm̐ bzhengs shig zhing skyong rnams bzhengs shig /ga ya dha ra sku bskyod 'tshal// pho brang mkha' spyod tsa ri nas// bdud mgon seng gdong yab yum la// nag po stong dang sha za 'bum// ma mo bye ba'i tshogs kyis bskor// 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes// sgrub la bar du gcod pa yi// dgra bgegs ma lus zhi bar mdzod// oṃ ma hā kā la singha mu kha pañtsa a mṛ ta la khā hi/ ga ṇa tsakra la khā hi/ zhes tshogs bstab cing*/ phud gtor la tshogs kyi phud gtor ma'i nang du blug nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha la 'bul ba ni/ gtor ma lnga po/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛ ta sogs nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gyi bar sngar lta bus byin gyis brlabs la/ pheṃ pheṃ pheṃ/ zhes gtor mgron spyan drangs/ pad skor rdo rje thal mo kha phye bas/ oṃ badz+ra ā ra li hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ dṛ sh+ya hoḥ lan gsum/ na mo rat+na gu ru i daṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum brjod/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bor gyur pa chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag /drin chen rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du i daṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ chos sku drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po/

tai lo shes rab bzang po/ nā ro dz+nyā na sid+dhi/ mar pa chos kyi blo gros/ mi la bzhad pa rdo rje/ dwags po zla 'od gzhon nu/ dpal ldan dus gsum mkhyen pa/ 'gro mgon ras pa chen po/ rgyal sras spom brag pa/ grub chen karma pak+shi/ mkhas grub o rgyan pa/ sems dpa' rang byung rdo rje/ rgyal ba g.yung ston chen po/ 'dzam gling chos kyi grags pa/ rtogs ldan mkha' spyod dbang po/ chos rje de bzhin gshegs pa/ rje btsun rat+na bha dra/ sprul sku mthong ba don ldan/ kun mkhyen 'jam dpal bzang po/ byang sems dpal 'byor don grub/ rgyal dbang chos grags rgya mtsho/ grub chen bkra shis dpal 'byor/ mtshungs med mi bskyod rdo rje/ rgyal ba dkon mchog yan lag rje btsun dbang phyug rdo rje/ gar dbang chos kyi dbang phyug rgyal mchog chos dbyings rdo rje/ dpal ldan ye shes snying po/ mtshungs med ye shes rdo rje/ dpal chen chos kyi don grub/ rgyal dbang byang chub rdo rje/ si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas/ rje btsun bdud 'dul rdo rje/ mi pham chos grub rgya mtsho/ pad+ma nyin byed dbang po/ theg pa mchog gi rdo rje/ rgyal sras blo gros mtha' yas/ kun bzang mkha' khyab rdo rje/ pad+ma dbang mchog rgyal po/ dpal ldan mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer/ rang byung rig pa'i rdo rje la sogs pa drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du i daṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ de'i rjes su/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye ha ri ni sa i dam+ba liṃ pū dza khā hi khā hi gṛ h+na ma ma rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ badz+ra ḍā ki nī/ bud+dha ḍā ki nī/ rat+na ḍā ki nī/ pad+ma ḍā ki nī/ karma ḍā ki nī/ bi shwa ḍā ki nī/ lo ka ḍā ki nī/ i dam+ba liṃ pū dza khā hi khā hi gṛ h+na ma ma rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ gsum mam/ bdun la sogs pas gtso 'khor dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams la phul te/

lha tshogs rnams kyi ljags hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje dmar po'i 'od kyi sbu gus bdud rtsi gtor ma gsol bas sku gsung thugs shin tu mnyes par gyur to// oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa ni ye ha ri ni sa shrī badz+ra yo gi ni badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ zhes 'don pa bsgyur te/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shab+da/ zhes dang*/ pañtsa a mṛ ta/ mā taṅgi la sogs pas mchod de/ oṃ bcom ldan rnam kun rdo rje phag mo che// 'jig rten gsum gzhan rgol bas mi tshugs shing*// 'byung po'i 'jigs pa ma lus rdo rje phag mos 'joms// rdo rje gdan bzhugs tshangs pa las rgyal zhing*// bdud kyi 'jigs pa ma lus skems shing pham mdzad ma// skyes gnas 'byung ba kun gyi rang bzhin gzugs// sa gsum dbang phyug chos rnams yongs rdzogs mdzad// rnal 'byor 'dod pa'i dbang phyug ma la 'dud// zhes pas bstod/ phyogs skyong la sogs pa'i 'byung po rnams/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba yak+ṣa rak+ṣa sa bhū ta pre ta pi sha tsa un+ma da a pa sma ra ḍā ka ḍā ki n+yā dā ya/ i dam ba liṃ gṛh+nan+tu sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu ma ma sarba sid+dhi m+me pra ya ts+tshan+tu ya thai baṃ ya thaiṣ+ṭaṃḥbhūñdza tha dzi gh+ra tha pi ba tha mā ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba kā ra ta ya sa ta su khaṃ bi shud+dha ye/ sā hā yi ka bha wan+tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ lan bzhir brjod/ oṃ hriṃ hriṃ haṃ haṃ he he hi hi pheṃ pheṃ/ zhes pa gsum sogs kyis mkha' 'gro ma rnams la 'bul lo// de nas/ zhing skyong chen po brgyad rnams dang*// mkha' 'gro sum cu so gnyis sogs// ma lus 'khor bcas 'dir byon zhing*// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod// ces pa'i bar gyis phrin las bcol lo// gtor chog gzhan nas bsnan pa lta bus yi dam chos skyong rnams la 'bul/ hūm̐ chos dbyings rnam dag ngang nyid las// 'gro ba'i don mdzad gzhan don du// ye shes sprul pa phyogs bcur 'gyed// rje btsun ma yi thugs dam bskang*// phag mo lha lnga'i thugs dam bskang*// gnas dang nye ba'i gnas la sogs// pul+li ra ma la sogs pa'i// yul chen nyi shu rtsa bzhi yi// dpa' bo dpa' mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// bskang ngo bskal pas thugs dam bskang*// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi// dam tshig nyams chags tshogs kyis bskang*// lta ba log pa gtor mas bskang*// srung ma g.yel na gtor mas bskang*// 'dir byon dam bskang phrin las mdzod// 'dod pa'i dngos grub bdag la stsol// thog med dus nas da lta'i bar// rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig la// nyams chags 'gal 'khrul ci mchis kun// mthol bshags bzod bzhes tshangs par stsol// oṃ sa ma ya/

āḥs ma ya/ hūm̐ sa ma ya/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye ha ri ni sa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ yig brgya brjod/ grub chen karma pa'i gsar bskong bkra shis sgo mang las khol du phyung ba'o// oṃ ma dag snod bcud stong par sbyangs// stong pa'i ngang las ye shes kyi// rlung me thod sgyed steng nyid du// thod par sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga// rlung mes bskol ba'i dam tshig pa'i// bdud rtsi rab 'bar 'od nyid des// ye shes bdud rtsi spyan drangs nas// dbyer med oṃ dang āḥhūm̐ gis// byin brlabs dri ro mtshungs med gyur// rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam lha tshogs dang*// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs spyan drangs// mdun gyi nam mkhar sprin bzhin gtibs par gyur// yi dam kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma mchod// dkon mchog kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma mchod// chos skyong kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma mchod// khyad par chos skyaung ber gyi na bza' can// dpal ldan lha mo rang byung rgyal mo ni// mched lcam 'khor dang bcas la mchod par bgyi// rgyal po rnam mang thos sras sngags kyi bdag /rdo rje legs pa srin mgon zhing skyong dang*// mkhar nag rdo rje rgyal po la sogs pa'i// karma pa yi bstan pa skyong rnams la// zag med sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga mchog gi /gtor ma rtsa brgyad pañtsa a mṛ ta// dza gad rak+ta'i yon chab mchod par bzhes// 'dod yon lnga dang gsang ba'i mchod pa dang*// de kho na yi kun bzang mchod pas mchod// khyod kyi skyon dag yon tan rdzogs pa de'i// gnas tshul ji bzhin rtogs pa'i sgo gsum gyi// bstod pa ma lus pa yis bstod par bgyi// khyod la 'dod don gsol ba btab pa ni// bdag sogs kun la mchog dang thun mong gi /dngos grub stan thog 'di la stsol ba dang*// khyad par tshe ring nad med dpa' 'byor rgyas// yid la bsam tshad skad cig tsam nyid la// grub nas karma pa yi bzhed pa kun// bdag gis ma lus myur du 'grub pa dang*// karma pa yi bstan la gnod byed rnams// bdag gis thal ba bzhin du rlog pa yi// nus pa da lta nyid du bstsal du gsol// de ltar mchod bstod dad pa'i dge ba des// ma gyur 'gro ba sems can thams cad kun// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas go 'phang 'thob phyir bsngo// zhes pa 'di ni rin chen dpal mos gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/

rje btsun karma pa mi bskyod rdo rjes gsungs pa'o// las kyi rdo rjes g.yas su thabs kyi rdzas sha lnga la sogs pa bza' ba dang*/ g.yon par shes rab kyi rdzas chang sna bzhi la sogs pa btung ba dag bzung ste/ slob dpon nas bzung ste rim pa ltar drang zhing*/ gzigs shig mdzes ldan dam pa'i chos// 'di la the tshom byar mi rung*// bram ze khyi dang gdol pa gsum// rang bzhin gcig par dgongs te rol// len pa pos kyang*/ bde bar gshegs pa chos kyi sku// 'dod chags dri ma dang bral bas// gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam par spangs// de bzhin nyid la bdag phyag 'tshal// a la la hoḥ zhes brjod cing blangs la phud bcad nas/ oṃ āgra piṇ+ḍa a shi bh+ya swāhā/ zhes phud la dbang ba'i 'byung po la sbyin no// ting 'dzin gsal bas dam tshig dang mi 'gal bar bza' btung la longs spyod de/ de nas phud dang lhag ma rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdus te/ oṃ ā kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma ṇāṃ ād+ya nut+pan+na tā twa oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ phud dang lhag ma'i gtor ma bzang zhing rgya che la zad mi shes pa 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan par gyur/ hūm̐ gzhan yang las kyi mkha' 'gro ma// shin tu 'jigs pa'i keng rus gzugs// yan lag rus pa'i 'khor los brgyan// snying khrag rngub cing rkan sgra sgrogs// rkang mgyogs brtul zhugs gdug rtsub can// dam tshig can gyi las mkhan yin// dam tshig nyams pa'i srog gcod yin// phud lhag bshal chu'i gtor ma bzhes// dkon mchog gsum gyi bstan pa srungs// da res nyul la mel tshe mdzod// hūm̐ 'jig rten mkha' 'gro rdzu 'phrul can// srin po'i lus la lce spyang gdong*// sbrul nag lce la spyan mig glog /kha rlangs dug la nga ro 'brug /mi lpags g.yab mo phyogs bcur brdeb// rgyu zhags 'dom dgus dgra bo 'ching*// khros pa'i smin phrag ser chen 'bebs// bye ba dung phyur sa ma ya// baspu mtshon cha me ltar 'bar// dam tshig can gyi las mkhan yin// dam tshig nyams pa'i srog gcod yin// phud lhag bshal chu'i gtor ma bzhes// dkon mchog gsum gyi bstan pa srungs// da res nyul la mel tshe mdzod// hūm̐ sha za'i mkha' 'gro yang sprul tshogs// yi dwags lus la dur bya'i gdong*// chu srin rkan la thod pas brgyan// lus la rnag khrag chu ser lhags// smre sngags tshig la ngu 'bod dbyangs// phyi nas 'dre tshubs sprin bzhin ldang*// bkra mi shis shing rjes ngan gtong*// ro langs rkang pas dur khrod nyul// phung sri lag pas srog rtsa gcod// gza' srin mig gis zla tshes blta// dam tshig can gyi las mkhan yin// dam tshig nyams pa'i srog gcod yin// phud lhag bshal chu'i gtor ma bzhes// /ri gsum 'grim zhing lung gsum bskor// chu la zhon nas grib so 'grim// dkyil 'khor mtha' ma bskor zhing nyul// dam tshig can gyi las mkhan yin// dam tshig nyams pa'i srog gcod yin// phud lhag bshal chu'i gtor ma bzhes// dkon mchog gsum gyi bstan pa srungs// da res nyul la mes tshe mdzod// oṃ u ts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba l+yīng bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa si swāhā/ zhes rol mo dang bcas pas phyi rol du dor ro// de nas rgyas bsdus gang yang rung ba'i mchod pa gsum phul la/ oṃ shrī badz+ra wārā hī badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ de bzhin du puṣ+pe sogs nas/ shab+da'i bar dang*/ pañtsa a mṛ ta āḥhūm̐/ mā taṅgi āḥhūm̐/ hrīḥzhal gcig spyan gsum ljags 'dril zhing*// zhal gdangs mche ba rnam par gtsigs// sku mdog rab dmar 'od zer 'bar// snang stong skye med sku la bstod// 'dzum pa'i mdangs ldan bzhad pa'i zhal// gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu yis// hūm̐ phaṭa la sogs sgra sgrogs ma// grag stong dbyer med gsung la bstod// g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang 'jigs byed dang*// dus mtshan bsgyel ba'i gdan steng na// sna tshogs me 'od bdud 'dul ma// rtog med mgo phreng can la bstod// g.yas na dam nyams srog gcod gri// g.yon na bdud rtsi'i ka pā la// rigs stong rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan can// lha yi lha la phyag 'tshal bstod// bde stong bla ma yid bzhin gyi// nor bu gtsug gi rgyan ldan ma// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// yum gyur ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod do// ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni// bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal pa// de kun mgon la bzod par gsol// gang yang bdag blo rmongs gyur pas// legs spyad 'di la nyes gyur gang*// gang phyir lus can skyabs yin phyir// de kun mgon khyod bzod par gsol// rdzogs sangs rgyas dang lha rnams dang*// de sras rnams dang tshangs la sogs// 'jig rten skyong rnams cho ga 'di'i// ma tshang ba dag bzod par mdzod// ces dang*/

yi ge brgya pa brjod pas lhag chad nor 'khrul la sogs pa rnams bzod par gsol te/ thal mo sbyar bas 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab cing*/ lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang*// des gsungs tshig kyang mchog tu tshad ma ste// bden pa de yis lha mo mchog gis ni// bdag la rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /rigs su skye dang dam tshig can// smyo med kyai yi rdo rje ston// bla ma la gus snying rje ldan// skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /lag pas rdo rje dril bu 'khrol// zab mo'i chos ni klog pa dang*// btsun mo'i shu kra mnyam zas can// skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /sems can thams cad sdig med cing*// sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /gang gi lam nas 'gro ba yi// sangs rgyas nyid dang 'phrad par shog /ma brgal ba rnams bsgral ba dang*// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis grol// da lta nyid du rjes brtse bas// rnal 'byor bstan bcos gnas la 'god// bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse phyir// nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni// ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyis pa// de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol// dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /yi dam lha tshogs 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog /ces smon lam btab bo// bkra shis brjod pa ni/ bka' brgyud bla mas legs byin pa'i// rtag tu ye shes thugs rje yis// gzigs shing chos sku ngo sprod pa'i// byin brlabs mchog gi bkra shis shog /rdo rje phag mos legs byin pa'i// gsang sngags mchog gi cho ga la// lus ngag yid gsum mthu grub pa'i// dngos grub mchog gi bkra shis shog /rdo rje mkha' 'gros legs byin pa'i// sems nyid 'od gsal 'dus ma byas// gnyis med dpe bral don rtogs pa'i// phyag rgya chen po'i bkra shis shog /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gros legs byin pa'i// chos rnams rang bzhin rang gi sems// rgyud 'di chos kyis ma bcings pa'i// chos kyi phyag rgya'i bkra shis shog

/rin chen mkha' 'gros legs byin pa'i// yon tan dpag tu med pas brgyan// nad dang gdon las thar ba yi// bsam pa 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /pad+ma mkha' 'gros legs byin pa'i// thabs dang shes rab gnyis med sbyor// bde chen ye shes thabs kyi mchog /gsang ba shes rab bkra shis shog /las kyi mkha' 'gros legs byin pa'i// rnal 'byor dam tshig ldan pa la// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las rnams 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /'jig rten mkha' 'gros legs byin pa'i// 'gro ba'i bsam pa rab shes nas// thabs rnams du mas 'dul mdzad pa// mngon shes drug ldan bkra shis shog /dpa' bo rnams kyis legs byin pa'i// rdo rje gsum gyi 'od zer gyis// bgegs rigs stong phrag zhi ba dang*// sku gsung thugs kyi bkra shis shog /lha mo rnams kyis legs byin pa'i// 'byung ba lnga yi spro bsdu yis// bde bar gshegs pa mnyes mdzad pa'i// yang dag mchod pa'i bkra shis shog /chos skyong rnams kyis legs byin pa'i// 'khor bzang longs spyod ldan pa dang*// nad dang gdon las thar ba yi// bar chad med pa'i bkra shis shog /de nas gshegs su gsol ba ni// oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas zhing du gshegs su gsol// sangs rgyas zhing du gshegs nas kyang*// sems can rnams kyi don slad du// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// oṃ badz+ra wārā hi badz+ra muḥ zhes ye shes pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs nas dam tshig pa rnams rang gi snying ga'i gnas su/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gyis bsdu/ brtan bzhugs byed na/ bkra shis ma brjod pa'i gong du/ ye shes pa rnams sku gsung thugs kyi rten 'di dag la 'byung ba chen po bzhi'i gnod pas ma zhig gi bar de srid du brtan par bzhugs su gsol// oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra swāhā/ zhes gzhug go /mchod sbyin gnas 'dir gang lhag pa'i// 'byung po sa 'og rgyu ba dang*// gang yang sa steng 'khod pa dang*// sa blar rgyu ba gang yin pa// mgu bar gyis la rang gnas su// thams cad tha dad 'gro bar gyis// sarba bhū ta gats+tsha/
